title: Lead Project Manager
description:
Remote Real Estate Project Manager



Miami  Real Estate Management Company

Remote Position | Full-Time



About the Position



We are an established real estate management company seeking a highly organized, motivated, and dependable Remote Real Estate Project Manager to join our property management and maintenance operations team.



This is an important management and coordination position within our company. The Project Manager will serve as a central point of communication between our tenants, office staff, and in-house maintenance team to ensure that maintenance issues and property-related projects are properly documented, coordinated, followed up on, and brought through to completion.



This is not a maintenance or construction position. You will not be performing repairs yourself. Your responsibility is to manage the process remotely—making sure communication is handled professionally, assignments are followed up on, outstanding items continue moving forward, and nothing falls through the cracks.



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their responsibilities and enjoys bringing organization and accountability to a fast-moving environment.



Previous real estate or property management experience is NOT required. We are more interested in finding someone who is exceptionally organized, communicates well, follows through, and is comfortable managing many different tasks at the same time.



What You’ll Be Doing



As our Remote Project Manager, you will remotely oversee the progress of maintenance requests and other property-related matters across our New York City portfolio.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Monitoring incoming tenant communications and maintenance-related matters.

* Reviewing open maintenance requests and understanding what needs to be accomplished.

* Following up with tenants when additional information, access, scheduling, or confirmation is required.

* Communicating professionally with tenants regarding scheduling, progress, and completion of repairs.

* Coordinating remotely with our in-house maintenance supervisors and maintenance personnel.

* Making sure maintenance requests are assigned to the appropriate team members.

* Following up consistently with the maintenance team until assigned repairs are completed.

* Tracking outstanding work and identifying items that have not progressed as expected.

* Keeping detailed and organized records of open projects, communications, follow-ups, and completed work.

* Maintaining and updating Excel spreadsheets and internal tracking systems.

* Reviewing outstanding items daily and making sure appropriate follow-ups occur.

* Coordinating access between tenants and maintenance personnel.

* Making sure tenants receive appropriate updates rather than having to repeatedly contact the company for information.

* Obtaining updates, photographs, and completion information from the maintenance team when appropriate.

* Escalating urgent, delayed, or complicated matters to management.

* Confirming that work has been completed before closing out outstanding items.

* Sending professional close-out communications to tenants when repairs are completed.

* Helping management maintain visibility into what is outstanding, what is in progress, and what has been completed.

* Managing multiple active projects and maintenance matters simultaneously.

* Working closely with company management to improve organization, response times, communication, and accountability throughout the maintenance process.



What We’re Looking For



The most important qualification for this position is exceptional organization and follow-through.



You should be the type of person who does not need to be repeatedly reminded about an outstanding item. If something is assigned to you, you keep track of it, follow up on it, and continue managing it until there is a clear resolution.



The ideal candidate will have:



* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

* Strong Microsoft Excel skills

* Exceptional organizational abilities

* Excellent attention to detail

* Strong follow-up skills

* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

* Ability to prioritize urgent versus routine matters

* Strong time-management skills

* Professional written communication

* Ability to communicate confidently with tenants, employees, supervisors, and management

* Ability to maintain detailed records

* Comfort working independently in a remote environment

* Ability to stay focused and productive without constant supervision

* Strong problem-solving abilities

* A proactive rather than reactive approach to work

* Ability to learn new software and systems quickly

* Good judgment regarding when an issue should be escalated to management



Real Estate Experience Is NOT Required



Prior real estate management or property management experience is not necessary for this position.



We can teach the right candidate our systems, terminology, procedures, and maintenance workflow.



What is much harder to teach—and what we value most—is someone who is naturally organized, responsible, professional, persistent, and capable of managing a large number of moving pieces.



Candidates with backgrounds in project management, operations, customer service, administrative management, office management, hospitality, construction coordination, executive assistance, logistics, scheduling, or other fast-paced environments may be particularly well suited for this position.



Excel & Technology



Strong computer skills are important.



You should be comfortable working extensively with Microsoft Excel,
, online property-management systems, messaging platforms, and other digital tools.



You do not need to be an advanced Excel programmer, but you should be very comfortable maintaining spreadsheets, organizing information, updating project statuses, filtering information, and using Excel as a daily management and tracking tool.



The Type of Person Who Will Succeed Here



You may be an excellent fit if you are someone who:



* Keeps extremely organized to-do lists.

* Enjoys checking items off only after they are actually completed.

* Notices when something has been sitting unresolved for too long.

* Doesn’t assume someone else will handle an issue.

* Is comfortable following up multiple times when necessary.

* Can handle many conversations and projects without becoming disorganized.

* Communicates professionally even in difficult situations.

* Understands that good project management requires both urgency and attention to detail.

* Takes pride in being the person who keeps an operation organized.

* Wants responsibility and the opportunity to become an important part of a growing organization.



Career Opportunity



This is much more than a basic administrative position.



The person hired will have meaningful responsibility for helping coordinate the day-to-day operations of a substantial New York City real estate portfolio and will work closely with our management and maintenance teams.



For the right candidate, this position offers the opportunity to develop significant experience in New York City real estate operations, property management, project management, maintenance coordination, and business operations without needing previous real estate experience.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a valuable long-term member of the company, take on increasing responsibility, and grow professionally as they learn our portfolio and operations.



This position provides exposure to the day-to-day operations of a professional New York City real estate organization while offering the flexibility of working remotely.



Position Details



Position: Remote Real Estate Project Manager

Industry: Real Estate / Property Management

Location: Remote

Portfolio: New York City

Schedule: Full-Time

Experience: Prior real estate experience not required

Key Skills: Organization, Excel, communication, follow-through, multitasking, project management, and attention to detail



How to Apply



Please submit your resume along with a brief introduction explaining why you believe you would be a strong fit for this position.



In your application, we would especially like to hear about your experience managing multiple responsibilities, projects, deadlines, customers, or team members at the same time.



We are looking for a motivated individual who wants a serious long-term opportunity, enjoys responsibility, and is ready to become an integral part of a fast-paced New York City real estate operation.

title: Marketing Director
description:
Marketing Director – Workers' Compensation Law Firm (Remote)



Location: Remote | Full-Time | US EST Hours Required







A busy, growing US law firm representing injured workers is seeking a talented, organized, and self-driven Marketing Director to take full ownership of its marketing function. This is not a support role — you will be the marketing department, and we're looking for someone who thrives with that kind of ownership and responsibility.







We have a lot going on. We run Meta ad campaigns, weekly email marketing, a robust relationship-marketing program that includes handwritten cards, monthly attorney newsletters, quarterly physician outreach, and two annual client events. We also work with an outside digital marketing agency that manages our website and SEO. What we need is someone who can take all of these moving pieces, bring them into a cohesive system, and drive real results.







What You'll Own



Your day-to-day will span a wide range of activities. On the paid digital side, you'll plan, build, and optimize our
 and Instagram ad campaigns to reach injured workers who need legal help. You'll also manage our relationship with our digital marketing agency — reviewing their work, holding them to clear performance benchmarks, and pushing them to deliver better results on our website and search presence.







On the relationship marketing side, you'll manage our KEAP CRM and ensure our weekly emails go out consistently and effectively. You'll oversee our monthly handwritten thank-you and birthday card program, our monthly business-tip letters to referring attorneys, and our quarterly outreach to physicians in our network. These programs are already running but need someone to systematize and elevate them.







You'll also plan and execute two annual events, our Santa Brunch and our Bingo Night, from initial logistics through invitations, execution, and post-event follow-up.







Finally, you'll take the grassroots community campaigns we've been running informally and build them into organized, repeatable efforts with clear goals and tracking.







What We're Looking For



Above all else, you need to be exceptionally organized. This role has many moving parts and many recurring deliverables — if anything slips through the cracks, the whole program suffers. You should be someone who lives by their calendar, builds systems naturally, and follows through without being chased.







Beyond organizational experience, we're looking for hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager and lead-generation campaigns, ideally in legal, medical, or another consumer-facing industry. You should be comfortable with KEAP or a comparable CRM and email automation platform. You should have sufficient digital marketing knowledge to have intelligent, challenging conversations with our external agency and to recognize when they're underperforming. Experience managing events, even small ones, is a plus.



Strong written English is essential. You'll be producing content that represents our firm to injured workers, referring attorneys, and physicians, and the tone and quality of that content matter.



Experience in legal marketing is a plus, but not required. What matters more is that you understand B2C lead generation, relationship-based marketing, and what it means to serve people going through difficult times.







What Success Looks Like



In the first 90 days, you'll have audited everything we're doing, built a master marketing calendar, taken over management of all active programs, and launched or relaunched our Meta ad campaigns. Within six months, our agency will be performing better or we'll have made a change, our nurture sequences will be tightened, and we'll have a clear picture of what's driving new clients and what isn't.







Why Join Us



You'll have genuine ownership, a team that respects your expertise, and the resources to do the job well. Our firm has a clear mission: helping people who've been hurt on the job get the representation they deserve, and our marketing should reflect that. We're looking for someone who takes that seriously.



To Apply



Send your resume, a short note describing how you've managed multiple marketing programs simultaneously, and at least one example of a paid social or lead generation campaign you've run. Tell us about a marketing system or process you built from scratch. Applications without these details will not be considered.

Frontline Optics is a fast-growing, seven-figure eyewear brand built for firefighters, law enforcement, and EMS. We were founded by a retired firefighter and run by a small, tight-knit remote team. We sell through Shopify, Amazon, and wholesale, and we manufacture overseas.



We're not looking for another assistant. We're looking for someone who will own our operations: find problems, fix them, and close the loop without being told twice.

Inventory & forecasting: Maintain our forecasting sheet, monitor stock levels across our US warehouse and Amazon FBA, and d
 when to reorder.



Supplier & shipment management: Manage purchase orders and communication with our manufacturer in China, track production and shipments, and coordinate with our freight forwarder.



Cash-aware purchasing: Schedule supplier payments (deposits, net-60, net-90) so they line up with our cash flow plan.



3PL & fulfillment: Be the main contact for our warehouse, resolve fulfillment issues, and verify inventory counts.



Bookkeeping coordination: Work with our outside bookkeepers on month-end reporting, landed cost updates, wholesale cost tracking, and quarterly inventory checks.



Team leadership: Lead our VA team day to day, set priorities, remove roadblocks, and hold people accountable.



Systems & SOPs: Document and improve processes in our SOP system so the business runs without the founder in every decision.



Important: to show us you've read this post in full, start your application with the words "Frontline Ready." Applications without this will not be reviewed.



Reporting: Keep our KPI dashboard current and flag problems before they become emergencies.



What We're Looking For



3+ years in operations, supply chain, or e-commerce management, ideally with Shopify and Amazon brands



Experience working with overseas manufacturers (China preferred)



Advanced Google Sheets skills (formulas, lookups, building trackers)



Familiarity with QuickBooks or basic accounting concepts such as cost of goods, landed cost, and payables



Clear, confident spoken English. You'll be on regular video calls with the founder and vendors.



A track record of taking ownership: you implement solutions, not just identify problems



Stable internet connection and backup power



Available Monday-Friday 9am to 5pm Pacific Time



Compensation



$1,400–$1,550 USD per month, depending on experience

Long-term, full-time position with growth potential

Performance bonuses tied to a quarterly scorecard

title: High-Ticket Account Manager | US Clients
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a proactive client leadership role focused on driving long-term results and retention.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success in this role is driven by strong client retention, consistent communication, proactive account management, and client progress.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Your raise to USD 2,000/month is based on performance and is reviewed after your first 30–60 days upon passing quality standards.



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Block 1 (Client Hours): 6:00 AM – 12:00 PM PH Time (Mon–Fri)

- Block 2 (Team Meetings): 9:00 PM – 11:00 PM PH Time (Specific weekdays)

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:

P.S. We run multiple brands. Once hired for this position, you'll work for this brand:

title: Content Curator
description:
Tern is a venture-backed software company on a mission to reshape the $127B travel agency industry, by giving power back to the entrepreneurs who built it.



Nearly 98% of travel agencies are small businesses. These businesses have been chronically underserved by technology. We're here to change that. Our platform helps travel advisors run more efficient, professional, and profitable operations, giving them the modern infrastructure they need to lead the next chapter of travel.



But the impact goes beyond business. Travel advisors help clients move more intentionally through the world. When a traveler works with an advisor, they're more likely to avoid overtouristed hotspots and more likely to spend their dollars in places where they can do real good. That's the kind of travel we want more of.



At Tern, we believe in small business. We believe in the power of travel. And we're building the future of both.



CONTENT CURATOR



Every hotel on Tern has a page. Right now, too many of those pages are working against us. Our #1 hotel by itinerary volume, still shows photos from the 1970s. Other well-known properties have no photos at all. Descriptions read like they were written about no hotel in particular, because they were.



We're hiring two Content Curators, on a 6-month contract, to fix that one property at a time. You'll go hotel by hotel through our highest-volume properties, replace bad or missing photos with ones that actually make someone want to book, and rewrite descriptions so they read like a real person who's been there wrote them. This is production work: a defined queue, a clear bar for what "good" looks like, and a lot of properties to get through.



You'll start with our top 598 hotels, the properties that make up half of all itineraries booked on Tern, and keep going from there.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Work through the hotel content queue property by property, replacing outdated, low-quality, or missing photos with current, professional, sellable images

- Rewrite generic Giata descriptions into specific, accurate copy that reads like it was written about that hotel and no other

- Use an AI-generated first draft as a starting point for descriptions, then edit and verify rather than starting from zero

- Flag factual errors in Giata's data as you find them

- Use Tern's internal content override tool to publish your work directly to the property record

- Hit weekly volume targets against the 598 ? 5,229 property rollout without sacrificing quality

- Send regular async updates on progress and blockers to the team



WHAT YOU HAVE



- Exceptional written English: Non-negotiable. Your descriptions need to read as native-level, error-free, and specific, not machine-translated or generic.

- Sharp visual judgment: You can tell a current, professional, sellable hotel photo from a dated or low-quality one at a glance, and you know what makes a traveler want to book versus scroll past.

- A production mindset: You move fast through a high-volume queue without cutting corners. This is closer to focused, self-directed data work than open-ended research.

- Strong communication: You're comfortable sending regular async updates and collaborating with a distributed team across time zones.

- High agency: You're not just clearing the queue, you're looking for problems and ways to make the process better as you go.



BONUS POINTS



- Familiarity with the travel or hospitality industry

- Experience with content moderation, cataloguing, or other high-volume QA-style production work

- Basic understanding of stock photo licensing or image usage rights



HOURS



This role is aligned with the rest of Tern's PH team schedule. You will be a part of the Tern team in the Philippines. That runs from 4am to 12pm PH time. We're flexible on exact start time as long as the work is getting done and you're available for team syncs (4pm ET/ 4am PH).

title: Support Specialist- Phone based Travel Booking Support
description:
You aren't answering tickets or calls to just hit a metric, you are the frontline voice that directly shapes our product and user experience. The support team is the foundation that determines whether our users will succeed. You will help shape the future of support by rethinking and influencing how support should operate in the age of AI. If this sounds like you, we'd love to talk.



**Tern is moving to a 24/7 support model as our global user base grows. This role could include shifts outside of standard business hours, including evenings and weekends. We'll share specific schedule expectations during the interview process. Ideally we need 2 individuals to support US night shifts and weekends (daytime in PH).



ABOUT TERN

Tern is a venture-backed software company on a mission to reshape the $127B travel agency industry by giving power back to the entrepreneurs who built it.vNearly 98% of travel agencies are small businesses. These businesses have been chronically

underserved by technology. We're here to change that. Our platform helps travel advisors run more efficient, professional, and profitable operations giving them the modern infrastructure they need to lead the next chapter of travel. But the impact goes beyond business. Travel advisors help clients move more intentionally through the world. When a traveler works with an advisor, they're more likely to avoid overtouristed hotspots and more likely to spend their dollars in places where they can do real good. That's the kind of travel we want more of. At Tern, we believe in small business. We believe in the power of travel. And we're building the future of both.



Support Specialist

The support team at Tern is the foundation that determines whether our advisors and agencies

succeed on the platform. Most support orgs at this scale are still reacting and focusing support

solely on the queue. More tickets, more headcount, repeat. Tern is different. AI is embedded into

almost every single workflow as a force multiplier for our human team and it's most critical on

the support function. And, with AI supporting the majority of our customer service volume, our

expert team of ICs can be deployed elsewhere where the human touch really matters. If you’re

looking to be at the forefront of our mission to empower travel advisors with innovative

technology, making their work more efficient and their impact more significant, and equally help

define what our support org will look like long term, this role is for you. You will provide top-tier

support to our partners, troubleshoot technical issues, become an expert in our product and AI

capabilities, and collaborate closely with our product and engineering teams.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Customer Support: Be a champion for our customers, representing their needs within Tern and ensuring their voices are heard by providing prompt, professional, and effective support to travel advisors, resolving issues and ensuring their success with Tern's solutions primarily through chat, phone,
, and 1:1's.

- Technical Troubleshooting: Identify, diagnose, and resolve technical problems, providing expert guidance and clear communication

- Product Mastery: You are quick to learn and navigate complex technology platforms, and you enjoy staying ahead of the curve. You'll become a Tern product expert, using your knowledge to assist customers and provide valuable feedback to our internal

teams.

- Knowledge Sharing: Create and maintain clear, comprehensive support documentation to help users find answers quickly

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product and engineering to surface relevant feedback on our offerings and ensure customer feedback is incorporated into our roadmap

- Continuous Improvement with AI: Build and deploy ways to enhance our support processes and overall customer experience to be improved, using AI and automation tooling to improve your personal productivity as well as the team’s



WHAT YOU HAVE

-Customer-obsession: You genuinely care about making life easier for our users and are committed to learning about our users, product, and team in depth to make that possible. You'll be the frontline voice of our customers- your problem solving and insights will directly influence product development and customer retention

-Customer phone calls: You're experienced taking customer phone calls in high-pressure/time-sensitive situations, know how to de-escalate, can multitask to find information

- Previous travel industry experience: Whether you've worked for an online travel

agency, have been or are a travel advisor 

-Technical curiosity and strong communication: While you don't need to be an engineer, familiarity with APIs, AI, and automation tools is a big plus. Even if you don’t know how to use each of these resources, you’re willing and eager to dig in. You can translate technical concepts into easy-to-understand language for non-technical users.

- User-facing enablement: You’re just as comfortable in the queue as you are creating a walk through video or hosting a live 1-1 training to close the ticket. You deploy the right lever for the right problems to resolve issues quickly and effectively.

-A fast learner: You pick up new tools, concepts, and workflows quickly, and you thrive in fast-moving, high-energy environments. You know how to approach becoming an expert in our product quickly, understanding both the technical and strategic ways advisors use it.

-Startup mindset: You're scrappy, adaptable, and ready to figure things out. You thrive on solving problems and are known for your attention to detail. You are comfortable in a fast-paced environment and can easily shift priorities as needed.

NICE-TO-HAVE

-Travel enthusiast: A love for travel is a plus; understanding the travel industry helps you connect with our customers on a deeper level. Having professional experience in the industry is a huge plus.

-Proficiency in support automations: You have the reps and excitement to build smarter workflows, leverage AI, and create self-service solutions to make support faster and more efficient

-Experience in SaaS support: Prior customer support experience is preferred, but we care more about raw talent and drive than years of experience.



WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT TERN

-Growth potential: Our team has an outsized impact at a quickly scaling company. This is your chance to get in early, grow fast, and learn.

-Work with the best: Join a team of top-tier engineers, designers, and operators building the future of travel tech

-Make an impact: Your work will directly shape the experience of thousands of travel advisors and their clients

Be a part of the hustle: Expect to wear multiple hats, learn quickly, and embrace the fast-paced nature of startup life



BONUS POINTS

-Experience providing technical or phone support for SaaS applications, preferably experience with Tern

-Experience in the travel industry

-Experience with Tern's primary tools: Intercom, Notion, Slack

-Experience utilizing AI



WHAT WE 

🌱 We're always leveling up. Whether you're deepening your craft, learning from a teammate, or embracing a new challenge, growth is core to our identity.

🧭 We act with optimistic agency. We take initiative, seek clarity, and move forward, even when the path isn't obvious. Through every peak and valley, we lead with curiosity, laughter, kindness, and resolve.

💪 We expect operational excellence. We ship value to our users every single week. We believe that compounding habits lead to sustainable productivity, consistency, and mutual trust.

Operating Principles:

👂 We deeply understand our users. At every level of the organization, we obsess about understanding those we serve and the industry we operate in.

➕ We embrace the power of and, and not now. We challenge trade-offs by asking better questions. We break hard problems into small pieces and tackle them with intention. We also know to make the hard call to say "not right now"

📣 We speak up and move forward. Everyone at Tern has a voice and a responsibility to use it. We invite healthy tension, share dissenting views early, and challenge each other with curiosity, not ego.

🧭 We move fast and sweat the details. Velocity matters and relentless progress beats perfection every time. But speed isn't chaos: we stay aligned, own our outcomes, and care deeply about quality.

🤣 We take the work seriously, but not ourselves. We hire kind, driven people who elevate the room. If you've got a big ego or take yourself too seriously, you won't last.

description:

What you'll do



You'll write detailed image prompts and create ultra-realistic AI photos. Then you'll turn them into video with Seedance 2.5. You should know how to get the most out of it: image-to-video, keeping characters consistent from shot to shot, controlling camera movement, and writing prompts that make motion look natural instead of glitchy or "AI-looking."

title: Senior Transport Operations Officer (Dispatch / Fleet Management / Transport Operations)
description:
Job Description

Company: Priority Haulage Limited

Job Title: Transport Operations Officer

Job Type: Remote / Part-Time 

Job Hours: ~20 Hours Per Week

Reports to: Operations Manager

Direct Reports: Transport Operations Support

Start Date: June 2026



About Priority Haulage

Priority Haulage is a reputable and reliable heavy machinery and equipment transport business based in Auckland, New Zealand. We specialise in the safe and efficient transportation of a wide range of civil machinery and heavy access equipment. 



Our company motto, “Your Assets, Our Priority”, reflects our commitment to the secure and dependable movement of our clients’ valuable machinery. We take pride in delivering a high level of client satisfaction through trusted service and operational excellence.



Job Summary

Priority Haulage is seeking a capable, high-capacity, and dependable Transport Operations Officer to support day-to-day operations within a fast-paced, high-accountability environment.



The role reports primarily to the Operations Manager and works closely with the Financial Controller on systems, process improvement, and operational coordination initiatives.



This position is central to maintaining operational continuity across fleet dispatch, driver management, compliance coordination, and transport administration within a structured, performance-driven business focused on operational efficiency, accountability, and scalable systems.



Role Overview

This role is suited to an operations professional who can consistently deliver reliable outcomes with minimal supervision in a deadline-driven environment. Performance will be assessed based on operational consistency, responsiveness, task completion, communication quality, and ability to maintain established workflows and standards.



Availability & Working Hours

This role requires consistent coverage aligned with New Zealand business operations, including early morning dispatch coordination and operational responsiveness throughout the day.



Core Operational Coverage (PHT)

5:00 AM – 1:00 PM: Primary operational window covering fleet dispatch, job loading, driver coordination, and daily operational tasks.



2:00 PM – 5:00 PM: Flexible operational coverage period supporting job closing activities, operational follow-up, and preparation/loading for the following operational cycle as required.



The role is workflow and task-driven, with hours and workload fluctuating depending on job volume, fleet activity, and operational requirements. Compensation is based on actual hours worked.



Final working arrangements and compensation structure will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate based on operational requirements, workflow demands, and demonstrated capability within the role. The position is expected to require approximately ~20 - 25 hours per week, with baseline workload increasing as operational responsibilities expand.



Job Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities



Fleet Dispatch

• Job Processing

• Job Quality Control



Fleet Management

• Fleet Maintenance Coordination

• EROAD Management

• Fuel Management



Driver Management

• Logbook Compliance

• Leave Management

• Uniform Inventory Management

• Driver Records Management

• Performance Management Support



Operational Support & Administration

• Support cross-functional operational workflows.

• Maintain accurate operational records and documentation.

• Assist with operational coordination and process improvement.

• Support internal communication, task coordination, and workflow follow-up.

• Assist leadership with operational reporting and action tracking where required.



Progressive Responsibilities

The successful candidate will progressively support and coordinate additional operational safety and compliance functions as part of the wider operations role, including:



• Compliance & Risk Support

• Insurance Claims Coordination

• Health & Safety Administration



Required Experience & Capability

Applicants should demonstrate proven experience operating within a structured, deadline-driven transport or logistics environment:

• Minimum 6+ years’ hands-on experience managing high-volume transport dispatch, fleet coordination, and operational workflows.

• Proven experience within transport, logistics, dispatch, or fleet operations environments.

• Strong organisational and commercial judgement, with the ability to manage multiple operational priorities simultaneously.

• Demonstrated experience using Transport Management Systems (TMS), fleet management platforms, dispatch systems, or operational workflow software.

• Ability to operate independently within a remote work environment

• Effective problem-solving capability and operational judgement.

• Intermediate Microsoft Excel capability, including, filtering, sorting, and pivot tables

• A high level of technical proficiency across the Microsoft platform and modern operational business systems, with working familiarity in tools such as:

o Notion

o ChatGPT



Preferred Experience 

• Exposure to New Zealand or Australian transport and logistics environments.

• Exposure to health & safety, driver compliance, and quality control processes.

• Demonstrated ability to improve operational workflows through process optimisation, system improvement, or automation initiatives.

• Exposure to coordinating, supporting, or overseeing operational staff within a structured operations environment.



Personal Attributes

• Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities reliably.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to contribute effectively.

• Proactive and improvement-oriented, with the ability to adapt, optimise workflows, and navigate operational change.

• Professional, dependable, and accountable, with strong follow-through and responsiveness.

• Able to remain calm and organised within a fast-paced operational environment.

• Strong ownership mindset with consistent follow-through and responsiveness.



Required Equipment and Setup

• Dedicated Workspace: Quiet, distraction-free home office suitable for video calls and focused work.

• Computer Requirements (Desktop PC or Laptop):

o Processor: Intel Core i5 or better.

o RAM: Minimum 8GB (16GB preferred).

o Operating System: Windows 10/11, compatible with required business software.

o Internet: Stable high-speed connection (minimum 10 Mbps download/upload).

• Monitor Setup: Dual monitors preferred, or a laptop paired with an external monitor.

• Headset: Noise-cancelling for clear communication during virtual meetings.

• Webcam: High-quality external or integrated camera for video calls.

• Power Backup: Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) or generator ensuring at least 3 hours of operational uptime during outages.

• Internet Backup: Secondary internet connection (e.g., mobile data or alternative wireless) for uninterrupted connectivity.



Application Requirement

In your application submission, include the word “Motivated!” in the title.

Job Description



Company: Priority Haulage Limited

Job Title: Financial Operations Manager

Job Type: Part-Time

Job Hours: Starting at ~15 hours per week, plus additional hours during the monthly close process (typically 15-20 hours in the first 2-weeks of each month).

Job Location: Remote

Start Date: August



About Priority Haulage



Priority Haulage is a reputable and reliable heavy machinery and equipment transport business based in Auckland, New Zealand. We specialise in the safe and efficient transportation of a wide range of civil machinery and heavy access equipment. 



Our company motto, “Your Assets, Our Priority”, reflects our commitment to the secure and dependable movement of our clients’ valuable machinery. We take pride in delivering a high level of client satisfaction through trusted service and operational excellence.



Job Summary



Priority Haulage is seeking a part-time, reliable and capable Financial Operations Manager to oversee day-to-day finance operations and support the monthly close process within a lean, systems-focused environment. 



Our finance function is built around well-documented processes, automation, and modern business systems. Routine bookkeeping and operational finance activities are supported by integrated and automated workflows, enabling the successful candidate to focus on financial accuracy, month-end reporting, continuous improvement, and optimising finance processes as the business grows.



Role Overview 



The primary responsibility of this role is the preparation and ownership of Priority Haulage's monthly management accounts and financial close process. Day-to-day financial operations support this objective by ensuring accurate, timely financial information is maintained throughout the month.



This role suits someone who is organised, dependable, systems-minded, and comfortable working autonomously within a structured operational environment. They will be confident using modern business systems and technology to optimise workflows and maintain strong financial controls.



Availability & Working Hours

This role requires consistent daily coverage during New Zealand morning business hours, with a structured morning schedule and flexible, outcome-focused afternoon support. Philippine Time (PHT) is typically 4 hours behind NZT (5 hours during NZ daylight saving).



Core Daily Hours (NZT)

9:30 AM – 12:00 PM NZT (5:30 AM – 8:00 AM PHT)

These hours are required each business day and cover core financial operations, daily processing, reconciliations, payroll coordination (Monday only), and communication with the New Zealand team.



The operational finance workload during this period is expected to be manageable within these core hours under normal operating conditions.



Month-End & Management Accounts Cycle

Additional hours are required during the monthly close process.



This includes:



• Close preparation during the final 1–2 business days of the month; and

• Completion of the monthly management accounts package within 8 working days following month-end.



During this period, responsibilities include:



• Reconciliations

• Working papers

• Management accounts preparation

• Review updates

• Close-related coordination



This workload is expected to average approximately 15–20 hours per month depending on the cycle and business activity.



Flexible Support & Process Improvement

Outside core operational and month-end responsibilities, additional flexible hours may be available to support:



• Finance process improvements

• Reporting and documentation enhancements

• Workflow optimisation

• Additional reconciliation and operational finance support as required



These hours will be agreed based on operational priorities.



Job Responsibilities



Reporting & Compliance

• Prepare monthly management accounts, reconciliations, and reporting using Xero and CCH Workpapers, ensuring accuracy and timely month-end close. 

• Support GST preparation and adherence to New Zealand accounting standards. 

• Maintain financial data integrity, documentation standards, and contribute to ongoing reporting improvements.



Bookkeeping & Financial Operations

• Perform day-to-day bookkeeping activities in Xero.

• Manage the general ledger and maintain the chart of accounts.

• Complete all required financial reconciliations accurately and on time.



Payroll Administration

• Review approved driver timesheets.

• Process weekly payroll, submit payments, and manage IRD filings.

• Ensure payroll accuracy and compliance with New Zealand standards.



Client Management

• Issue client statements and prepare, manage, and communicate job quotations.

• Resolve client account, billing, and payment enquiries.

• Support accounts receivable and debt collection activities via the Client Services Coordinator.



Supplier Management

• Manage supplier accounts, payments, reconciliations, and resolve queries.

• Coordinate subcontractor bills and ensure accurate reconciliation.

• Oversee recurring subscriptions, licensing, registrations, and compliance costs.



Operational Support & Continuous Improvement

• Drive process improvements, system optimisation, and efficiency opportunities.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to support timely, high-quality workflows

• Partner with leadership to ensure accurate and reliable financial data while contributing to automation initiatives.



Required Experience & Capability



Applicants should demonstrate proven experience operating in a structured, deadline-driven finance environment.

• Minimum 7+ years’ hands-on accounting experience.

• Advanced proficiency in Xero is essential.

• Strong Microsoft Excel capability, with proven ability to reconcile and analyse data using XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, and financial modelling functions.

• Proven experience preparing monthly management accounts, conducting financial analysis, and supporting budgeting and forecasting activities.

• Working knowledge of New Zealand tax regulations, accounting standards, and statutory compliance requirements.

• Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote environment, with strong self-management, reliability, and a consistent track record of meeting deadlines without oversight.

• Strong ability to collaborate cross-functionally, supporting finance-related workflows across the business.

• High level of technical proficiency, including the Microsoft platform, with working familiarity in modern business tools.



Preferred Experience 



• CPA qualification required, preferably a Regular Member of PICPA, with a recognised tertiary qualification in accounting.

• Experience within New Zealand or Australian Chartered Accounting firms, including use of CCH Workpapers.

• Exposure to a commercial business environment, ideally within transport, logistics, or fleet-based operations.

• Experience using Notion, ChatGPT, workflow automation tools, and modern business systems to improve finance operations, documentation, and process efficiency.

• A relevant tertiary qualification in finance, business administration, or a related field.



Personal Attributes



• Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities reliably.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to operate autonomously while contributing effectively in a remote team environment.

• Analytical and problem-solving capability, particularly in identifying, investigating, and resolving financial discrepancies.

• Proactive and improvement-oriented, with the ability to adapt, optimise workflows, and navigate operational change.

• Professional, client-focused mindset, demonstrating integrity, quality standards, and accountability in delivery.



Required Equipment and Setup



• Dedicated Workspace: Quiet, distraction-free home office suitable for video calls and focused work.

• Computer & Internet: Desktop PC or laptop with minimum Intel Core i5 processor, 8GB RAM (16GB preferred), Windows 10/11 compatibility, and a stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 10 Mbps upload/download).

• Monitor Setup: Dual monitors, or a laptop paired with an external monitor.

• Headset: Noise-cancelling headset for clear communication during virtual meetings where operating outside a fully quiet workspace.

• Webcam: High-quality external or integrated camera for video calls.

• Power Backup: Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) or generator ensuring at least 3 hours of operational uptime during outages.

• Internet Backup: Secondary internet connection (e.g., mobile data or alternative wireless) for uninterrupted connectivity.



Application Requirement

In your application submission, include the word “Motivated!” in the title.

title: UI/UX Designer / Game Tester for a video game
description:
I’m looking for a game UI/UX designer with a strong visual eye to help polish the interface of a roguelike indie game currently in active development.



The main priority is making the UI look attractive, cohesive, and polished. I want someone who can look at the current interface, spot what feels rough or visually awkward, and recommend specific changes that make it look and feel better.



You’ll review early builds and help refine everything from typography and spacing to colors, menus, and combat screens. Usability matters, but this role puts a strong emphasis on visual presentation.



What You’ll Help Improve



Overall visual polish: Make the interface feel intentional, cohesive, and ready for players.

Spacing and alignment: Clean up cramped layouts, uneven margins, and awkward positioning.

Color and contrast: Refine the palette so the UI looks appealing and communicates information clearly.

Menus and panels: Improve the presentation of inventory, character stats, abilities, upgrades, and other screens.

Combat screens: Make complex information look organized and easy to scan.

Visual consistency: Give buttons, borders, highlights, tooltips, and selected states a consistent style.

Navigation and player flow: Identify confusing interactions and unnecessary steps.



I’m looking for more than bug reports or general feedback like “this screen looks cluttered.” I want concrete design recommendations, annotated screenshots, or mockups that show how to improve it.



What I’m Looking For



A strong eye for visual design and game UI

Experience improving existing UI while preserving the game’s visual identity

Strong judgment about typography, layout, spacing, color, and visual hierarchy

Ability to explain your recommendations clearly and provide actionable examples

Comfort working with early builds and evolving systems



Experience with roguelikes, RPGs, or text-heavy interfaces is a strong bonus. You should understand how to make information-rich screens look appealing without sacrificing readability.





To Apply, Please Include



1. A short summary of your game UI/UX or visual design experience

2. Your portfolio, preferably with game interfaces or before-and-after examples

3. Examples of roguelikes or RPGs you’ve played, tested, or designed

4. Your availability

5. Your hourly rate in USD

 and calendar systems

CRM/job management software

title: Graphic Designer (Apparel) + Shopify Store Assistant
description:
Probation of 1 to 3 months at $500/month base, then a raise based on performance. Hours: 40 hrs/week, with some flexibility on your schedule



About us

XMartial is a combat sports apparel brand (Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, MMA, Muay Thai). We have served over 100,000 customers in 50+ countries with distinctive designs and high-quality gear. We move fast, we ship often, and our designs are the reason people buy from us instead of everyone else.



What this role is

You design our apparel. Rashguards, shorts, spats, gis, tees: you create the vector artwork, build the print files, and produce the mockups that go live on the store and into our ads.



Design is the core of the job and where most of your week goes. The rest of your time you work as a general store assistant, supporting whatever the store needs that week: uploading and organizing products in Shopify, resizing and preparing images, editing banners, fixing catalog issues, and other hands-on tasks.



This is an independent role. We give you the brief, the references, and the print specs, and trust you to deliver finished, production-ready work without being chased.



What you will do

Apparel design (the main job) + Shopify Store Assistant



Create original vector artwork for all-over-print combat sports apparel: rashguards, shorts, spats, gis, tees.

Build print-ready files that match manufacturer specs: correct dimensions, resolution, bleed, panel placement, and seam alignment across sizes.

Develop colorways and variations of existing designs, and keep whole collections visually consistent.

Work from a brief and from our existing style, while bringing your own ideas for designs you think will sell.



Mockups and visuals

Produce clean, realistic product mockups for the store, ads, and social.

Retouch and edit imagery in Photoshop so the catalog looks consistent and premium.

Create supporting graphics when needed: collection banners, promo images, product-page graphics.



General store assistant work

Upload and organize products in Shopify: images, variants, collections, tidying up messy or duplicate listings.

Prepare and resize assets for different placements across the store and ad channels.

Handle small ongoing tasks that keep the store accurate and up to date.



What we are looking for

Must have

Strong vector design skills in Adobe Illustrator. This is the core skill and we will test it.

Real experience designing apparel for print, ideally all-over sublimation. You understand how a flat file becomes a finished garment.

Photoshop skills for mockups and image retouching.

A portfolio of apparel or graphic design work. Required, no exceptions.

A strong eye for bold, modern design that fits combat sports culture.

Precision. Print files that are off by a few millimeters cost us real money, so details matter.

Willingness to do the non-design store tasks as well. This is not a pure design role.

Good written English and reliable communication.



Nice to have

You train BJJ, MMA, Muay Thai, or wrestling, or you genuinely follow the sport.

Shopify experience.

Comfort using AI tools (image generation, upscaling, background removal) to work faster.

Figma, or experience building tech packs and working directly with manufacturers.



How we work

Before each project we agree on the brief, the references, and the specs, so nothing is fuzzy. We move fast and ship often. Strong applicants get a short paid trial task (one rashguard design plus a mockup) before we finalize.



How to apply

All applications go through our form. We do not accept applications by email or DM.



Apply here: 



Have your portfolio ready, with at least a few apparel or print designs in it. To show you read this far, the form asks for a keyword: it is GRIP. Applications with the wrong or missing keyword are not reviewed.

title: Flooring Estimator (Take-Off) / Measure Square
description:
The role in one line

Use MeasureSquare 8 to measure flooring quantities from architectural plans for aged care facilities across Australia, and give our project team accurate, clearly labelled takeoffs they can price with confidence.



About us

Care Flooring Australia (CFA) specialises in flooring for Residential Aged Care Facilities (RACFs). We supply and install safety vinyl, carpet, carpet tiles and vinyl plank in resident rooms, ensuites, corridors, dining and lounge areas, kitchens, laundries and back-of-house spaces. Our projects run across NSW and QLD, and much of our work is done in occupied facilities where residents are living on site. That means staged work, tight timeframes and getting the details right the first time.

We are building a small remote team to support our project supervisors in Australia. This role is the first step in our estimating process: you measure, and our team in Australia prices and quotes.

What you will do

Receive architectural or facility PDF plans, finishes schedules and tender/scope documents for each job.

Receive hand-drawn plans that you re-create as a PDF.

Import plans into MeasureSquare 8, set and check the scale, and draw every room and area to be floored.

Assign the correct product and service to each area according to the finishes schedule (for example safety vinyl, carpet tile, broadloom, vinyl plank).

Plan roll layouts and seams for sheet vinyl and broadloom carpet so that waste is kept low and seams sit in sensible positions.

Calculate and report:

Supply quantities: lineal metres (LM) for roll goods, m² (and boxes) for tiles and planks

Installation metres (m² installed) for each product

Coving, cove former and capping strip (LM), and the number of internal and external corners for vinyl

Floor wastes (drains) and the accessories needed for each, with quantities

Weld rod (LM) for all seams and joins

Uplift (take-up) m² and floor preparation m²

Trims and transitions: door thresholds, ramps, strips and stair nosings

Room counts (resident rooms, ensuites), door openings and any stages or zones for occupied facilities

Cross-check your takeoff against the plans and scope before submitting it, and list any assumptions or questions clearly.

Complete the takeoff report in MeasureSquare 8 and notify the Project Supervisor in Australia that it is ready.

Keep a tidy, consistent file and naming structure so anyone in the team can pick up a job.

What this role does NOT include

No pricing, no quotations and no product selection. You will not contact clients or facilities directly. If something in the plans or scope is unclear, you raise it with the Project Supervisor.



What we are looking for

Attention to detail is everything in this role

One missed ensuite, a coving setting left off, or an old plan revision can cost thousands on a job. We need someone who checks every room, every setting and every line of the scope, every time, and who catches their own mistakes before anyone else sees them.



Please send us:

Your CV, including the takeoff software you have used and for how long

Use 6 apply points for your application

A short note (under 200 words) on a commercial flooring or construction takeoff you have completed

Your answer to this question: "A corridor is 32.5m long and 2.4m wide. It will be finished in 2m wide safety vinyl, coved 150mm up both walls. How would you work out the lineal metres of vinyl and the weld rod needed?"

Start your application with the words "Aged Care Takeoff" so we know you read the whole ad.

Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a paid or unpaid practical takeoff test on a sample plan.



Must have

Exceptional attention to detail. You check your own work thoroughly and methodically before handing it over.

At least 2 years of experience in flooring, construction or quantity estimating using digital takeoff software

Confident reading architectural plans, dimension strings, scales, legends and finishes schedules

Understanding of roll goods (sheet vinyl, broadloom carpet), including roll widths, run direction, seams and wastage

Good written English and the confidence to ask questions when something does not add up

A reliable computer that can run Windows desktop software, a second monitor, and stable high-speed internet with a backup



Nice to have

Hands-on experience with MeasureSquare (strongly preferred), or similar software such as Bluebeam, PlanSwift or On-Screen Takeoff

Experience with commercial, healthcare or aged care projects

Knowledge of safety vinyl installation: coving, cove former, welded seams, and wet areas with falls to floor wastes

Experience working for Australian companies and with Australian terms and metric measurements



Hours and working arrangements

Full time, Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week

Working hours

Mainly NSW business hours (Sydney time), with some flexibility. Start 9:00am Sydney time (9:00am–5:30pm). That is 7:00am–3:30pm Philippines time, or 6:00am–2:30pm during NSW daylight saving (October to April).

Location

Tools

MeasureSquare 8 licence provided by CFA. Communication mainly by
 and through MeasureSquare 8, with WhatsApp for calls

Reports to

Project Supervisor (Australia)

Pay

$1400AUD month

Trial

3 month probation



How we measure success

Turnaround- Takeoff completed within [.5-3] business days of receiving plans (depending on complexity)

Accuracy- Quantities within an agreed tolerance when checked against site measure or the final job

Clarity- Every takeoff lists its plan revision, stages, assumptions and queries

Communication- Project Supervisor notified the same day a takeoff is complete

description:
Reels 2 Revenue is a US-based social media agency. We produce 120 short-form reels a month for business owners and run the systems that turn views into booked sales calls.



We're hiring one skilled, full-time appointment setter. Your job comes down to one number: qualified strategy calls booked that actually show up. Everything else in this post exists to support that number.



"Qualified" means: they run a business or a personal brand that already makes money, and they're serious about investing to grow it. Booking unqualified people wastes the founder's time and doesn't count — we track show rate and call quality, not just bookings.



You will be trained on every tool and every process. We're hiring for setting skill, English, and reliability — not for knowing our software.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



1. Instagram DMs — the core of the job. Reply to every inbound message within 10 minutes during your shift, qualify with 2–3 sharp questions, handle objections, and book them onto a strategy call via our Calendly link. Then follow up until they show. You'll work inside ManyChat's inbox, not the Instagram app.



2. Funnel leads — every person who completes our quiz gets a text and an
 from you within 15 minutes, then a 5-day follow-up sequence until they book or say no. Confirm every call the day before. Chase every no-show.



3. Outbound — when the inbox is quiet, you work our warm list: people who engaged with our content, downloaded the roadmap, or booked and didn't show. Re-open the conversation and get them on the calendar.



4. Posting — publish 8 reels a day to our Instagram from the finished files our editors deliver: upload, caption, cover frame, scheduled times, posting log. The files arrive fully edited; you get them live. This is the support task, not the job.



5. CRM + daily report — every contact's status, notes and next action kept current. A 5-line end-of-shift summary in Slack: calls booked, calls confirmed, DMs handled, leads received, reels posted.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- Real appointment-setting experience — at least 2 years booking sales calls from DMs, chat, or inbound leads for a US, UK or Australian company. You'll be asked for your numbers: conversations per day, booking rate, show rate.

- Written English at a native level. You're writing to American business owners all day and they judge us on your first sentence.

- You can handle "how much is it?" without quoting a price. You understand why the price belongs on the call, and you can move someone there without being pushy.

- Available 9:00am–6:00pm US Pacific time, Monday to Friday (that's 12:00am–9:00am Manila). This is a night shift. Only apply if that genuinely works for you long-term.

- Stable internet (25 Mbps+) and a backup for power outages.

- Comfortable being measured weekly: response time, qualified calls booked, show rate, reels posted.



PAY



$1,000/month base, paid twice a month, plus $20 for every booked call that shows up — uncapped. Book 20 shows in a month and that's $400 on top of base; as our lead volume grows, so does your bonus. Paid holidays after 90 days.



HOW TO APPLY



Start the first line of your application with the word "Reels" so we know you read this. Then answer these five questions — short answers are fine:



1. Describe your appointment-setting experience. Include numbers: conversations per day, booking rate, show rate.

2. A lead DMs: "How much does this cost?" Write your exact reply, word for word.

3. What's your internet speed (run a speedtest and paste the result) and what's your backup plan for a power cut?

4. Confirm you can work 12:00am–9:00am Manila time, Mon–Fri, for at least 6 months.

5. Why this job, and not any other setter job?



Applications that skip the questions or the first word won't be read. The shortlist gets a paid 30-minute test task this week; we're hiring by Friday.

title: Meta Marketing Manager
description:
Meta Marketing Manager | DTC / E-commerce

Location: Remote



We're hiring a Meta Marketing Manager to own and scale B2C paid social performance across our two ecommerce brands, 
 and Let's Roam. You'll own the full performance loop — strategy, creative, launch, testing, analysis, and iteration — driving profitable growth in Contribution Margin. This is a hands-on role: you'll manage campaigns directly in Meta Ads Manager, use AI tools to rapidly develop and test high-performing creative, and directly impact revenue, CAC, and ROAS.



Brands:







About Let's Roam

Let's Roam is a startup (est. 2016) that helps people explore the world and connect with each other. Our culturally immersive scavenger hunts help people connect with their environment through team challenges and interactive games, while our corporate virtual team building events offer a fun and sophisticated way of bringing companies together and stay engaged with one another while living in a remote work environment. We plan on growing fast and you will have the opportunity to grow with us.



About You

We're looking for a highly hands-on Meta performance marketer who combines deep paid social expertise, strong DTC commercial instincts, and advanced AI-assisted creative production. This is not a traditional media-buying role. We want someone who can take a campaign from strategy → AI-assisted creative → launch → test → profitable scale. You should be an advanced user of AI creative tools like Claude or ChatGPT, using AI as a core part of your creative workflow to dramatically increase testing velocity and volume. You will own Meta strategy, creative production, and performance reporting across two consumer brands.



Project/Role Description

1. Meta Strategy & Growth

Own day-to-day Meta strategy, execution, and optimization across two B2C brands.

Develop profitable evergreen, promotional, and seasonal campaigns with long-term scalability.

Own campaign structure, budgets, bidding, targeting, and scaling decisions.

Monitor performance daily and quickly scale, optimize, or pause campaigns and ads based on profitability.

Identify growth opportunities across products, audiences, geographies, and occasions.

Develop structured testing roadmaps for campaigns, audiences, offers, and landing pages.

Diagnose performance across creative, campaign structure, offer, landing page, and conversion funnel.



2. AI Creative Strategy & Production

Own the Meta creative testing strategy across both brands.

Develop new hooks, concepts, offers, messaging angles, and creative hypotheses based on performance data and customer insights.

Use AI to rapidly create and iterate static ads, UGC concepts, short-form video, scripts, copy, and creative variations.

Analyze winning and losing ads to understand why they performed and determine the next iteration.

Monitor creative fatigue and continuously introduce new concepts and variations.

Build an AI-enabled creative workflow that increases both speed and volume without sacrificing quality.



3. Reporting & Performance Insights

Monitor and communicate performance on a daily and weekly basis.

Translate data into clear insights: what happened, why it happened, and what we should do next.

Analyze results by campaign, product, geography, audience, and creative.

Evaluate creative metrics including Hook Rate, CTR, CPC, CVR, CPA, ROAS, and Contribution Margin.

Present performance, opportunities, and strategic recommendations to senior stakeholders.



Key Competencies and Skills

Meta Ads Expertise

5+ years of hands-on Meta performance marketing, paid media, or user acquisition experience.

Proven success scaling B2C/DTC ecommerce Meta campaigns at significant budget levels, including personally managing $50K+/month in spend.

Experience with lower-AOV products, experiences, tours, activities, or purchases under $100 strongly preferred.

Strong knowledge of Meta's current Advantage+, automation, bidding, and campaign ecosystem.

Hands-on experience with Meta Conversions API, server-side tracking, attribution, and conversion troubleshooting.

AI-Enabled Creative Skills

Hands-on experience using generative AI for performance creative, including imagery, UGC concepts, video, scripts, and copy.

Experience building AI-enabled and automation-first marketing workflows that improve creative velocity, optimization, or reporting.

Strong performance creative instincts with the ability to identify winning hooks, angles, messaging, and formats.

Analytical & Reporting Skills

Deep understanding of Contribution Margin, MER, ROAS, CAC/CPA, AOV, CVR, and Revenue.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn complex data into actionable recommendations.

Strong direct-response copywriting, communication, and creative briefing skills.

Experience presenting campaign performance and strategy to senior stakeholders.

DTC / Ecommerce Commercial Instincts

Strong understanding of the full ecommerce funnel, including CRO, landing-page testing, offers, and checkout performance.

Experience managing multiple brands, accounts, or acquisition programs simultaneously.

Proven ability to scale nationally while maintaining profitability.

Highly organized, fast-moving, and comfortable taking full ownership in a remote environment.



Apply Now: We are interested in knowing the Meta campaigns you've scaled profitably, along with creative you've produced or directed — including any AI-assisted work. Let's build the future of exploration together.

This is an independent contractor position at Let's Roam. You will be working closely with our team in daily meetings and frequent check-ins.

title: Case Manager - Lemon Law
description:
Summary

**Remote | California Lemon Law Firm | Full-Time

 

** We are a California law firm focused on lemon law and consumer protection litigation, and we are looking for a licensed attorney to join our team as a Case Manager. 

 

This is a hands-on position for an attorney who can manage cases, communicate directly with clients, stay on top of deadlines, and move cases forward from intake through settlement. 

 

## What You’ll Do 

* Manage an assigned caseload from intake/retainer through settlement or resolution. 

* Communicate directly with clients, provide case updates, answer routine questions, and maintain strong client relationships. 

* Request, review, and organize documents and evidence from clients. 

* Review purchase documents, repair orders, warranty records, service history, manufacturer communications, and other case-related documents. 

* Analyze case facts and identify missing information, potential issues, and case strengths/weaknesses. 

* Draft legal documents, including pleadings, discovery, meet-and-confer correspondence, declarations, motions, settlement documents, and other case-related correspondence. 

* Prepare and file documents with the court and assist with e-filing as needed. 

* Track case deadlines, hearings, discovery obligations, settlement deadlines, and other important dates. 

* Coordinate with attorneys, paralegals, case managers, and other members of the team. 

* Maintain accurate and organized case files and case-management records. 

* Follow cases closely and make sure nothing falls through the cracks. 

* Escalate significant legal or case issues when attorney review or strategy decisions are needed. 

 

## What We’re Looking For **Required:** 

 

* An active attorney license in good standing. 

* Experience handling lemon law cases OR civil litigation. 

* Strong legal writing and analytical skills. 

* Excellent communication and client-management skills. 

* Ability to independently manage multiple cases and competing deadlines. 

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. 

* Ability to work independently in a remote environment. 

* Professional, responsive, and comfortable communicating directly with clients. 

 

## Preferred 

* Direct California lemon law experience. 

* Experience handling cases from intake through settlement. 

* Experience with pleadings, discovery, motions, settlement negotiations, and court filings. 

* Experience using case-management software such as Filevine. 

* Experience working in a remote law-firm environment. 

 

## The Ideal Candidate 

We are looking for someone who can own their cases rather than simply complete individual assignments. You should be comfortable communicating with clients, reviewing documents, drafting legal work, managing deadlines, coordinating with the team, and keeping a case moving without needing to be reminded about every next step. If you have lemon law experience, that's a strong advantage. If you have solid civil litigation experience and can learn the firm's lemon law process, we are also interested in speaking with you. 

 

## How to Apply 

 

Please submit your resume and a brief introduction explaining your relevant lemon law or civil litigation experience. 

 

### Important 

Read Before Applying To confirm that you have read the entire job posting, include the title and author of the latest book you've read in the subject line of your application. Applications that do not include the code word may not be considered.

title: Virtual Personal Assistant / Phone Support

This is a long-term position for someone who wants to become a trusted part of our team. A major part of your job will be helping manage phone calls, messages, scheduling, follow-ups, and administrative tasks so the director can stay focused on higher-priority work.



This is not just a data-entry position. We are looking for someone who can learn the business, think independently, communicate professionally, and eventually handle routine matters without needing instructions every time.



What You'll Do



Answer incoming business phone calls professionally.



Take detailed messages and determine which calls require immediate attention.



Handle routine questions when appropriate.



Make outbound calls and follow up with customers, employees, vendors, and other business contacts.



Help manage
 and identify messages requiring attention.

Confidence speaking with Americans by phone.



Strong attention to detail.
