title: Financial Operations Assistant: Bookkeeping & Cash Flow
description:
Financial Operations Assistant - Bookkeeping, Cash Flow & AI Systems



Part-Time | Remote | Philippines | 10–15 Hours/Week Initially



Hi! I'm Nia Thomas, founder and creative director of an independent luxury fashion brand.



The business is based in the United States and registered as an S-corporation in New York State, while our design and production operations are based in Mexico City. We sell through Shopify, wholesale, consignment, and custom orders.

I'm looking for an experienced, highly organized Financial Operations Assistant to take ownership of our bookkeeping and help me better understand the financial health of the business.



This role combines bookkeeping, cash-flow and profitability analysis, and financial systems/automation. I'm looking for someone who can clean up our current records, maintain them going forward, and create a simpler system for understanding where our money is going.



Immediate Priority: Financial Cleanup



Our QuickBooks Online account currently has bank-feed connection issues, and our bookkeeping needs to be brought up to date so our accountant can complete our outstanding tax filings.



Your first priorities will be:

- Diagnose our current QuickBooks Online bank-feed issues.

- Import, categorize, and reconcile missing transactions from 2025 and 2026.

- Reconcile bank and credit-card accounts while preventing duplicate transactions.

- Organize receipts, invoices, and financial records.

- Prepare accurate reports and documentation for our U.S. accountant.

- Work with our accountant as needed to ensure our records are complete and tax-ready.



I will be available whenever account-owner authorization, bank authentication, or 2FA is required.



Building a Better Financial System



Long-term, I'm interested in moving away from relying entirely on QuickBooks and exploring a more streamlined workflow using Lunch Money + Claude AI to organize and categorize expenses, analyze spending, and understand cash flow.



I'd love to find someone who already has experience with Lunch Money, Claude/AI-assisted bookkeeping, financial automation, or similar tools and can help me:

- Set up Lunch Money and connect/import our financial accounts and transactions.

- Create appropriate business and personal expense categories, tags, and rules.

- Use automation and AI to reduce manual expense categorization.

- Build a reliable workflow for reviewing AI-categorized transactions for accuracy.

- Export and organize the financial information our accountant needs.

- Determine which records should remain in an accounting system such as QuickBooks versus what can be managed through Lunch Money and other tools.

- Create a financial system that is accurate, easy to maintain, and doesn't require me to manually manage hundreds of transactions.



Ongoing Financial Operations



Once our books and systems are organized, responsibilities will include:

- Maintain accurate monthly financial records and reconciliations.

- Track revenue, expenses, cash flow, outstanding invoices, and upcoming payments.

- Create simple monthly financial reports and cash-flow forecasts.

- Track COGS, gross profit, and gross margin by product, including materials, labor, shipping, packaging, transaction fees, and other costs.

- Identify unnecessary spending and opportunities to improve profitability.

- Help evaluate production, inventory, factory, and supplier costs.

- Assist with budgeting and financial forecasting.

- Keep our financial information organized and ready for our accountant.



Required Experience



You should have:

- Strong bookkeeping experience and experience cleaning up overdue financial records.

- Experience with QuickBooks Online, including troubleshooting bank feeds and account reconciliation.

- Experience bookkeeping for U.S.-based businesses and preparing financial records for U.S. accountants/tax filing.

- Strong Google Sheets and/or Excel skills.

- Understanding of COGS, gross margin, cash flow, budgeting, and financial forecasting.

- Excellent written English, attention to detail, and ability to work independently.

- Comfort using technology, automation, and AI to improve financial workflows.



Experience with Lunch Money, Claude AI, AI-assisted bookkeeping/expense categorization, S-corporations, Shopify, e-commerce, inventory accounting, international suppliers, or multi-currency transactions is a major plus.



Hours



Approximately 10–15 hours per week initially while we complete the financial cleanup and establish our new systems.



Afterward, I expect the role to transition to approximately 5–10 hours per week for ongoing bookkeeping and financial analysis.

I'm looking for someone interested in building a long-term working relationship with the business.



To Apply



Please send:

- A brief introduction and your relevant bookkeeping/financial experience.

- Your experience troubleshooting QuickBooks and cleaning up overdue books.

- Any experience working with U.S. businesses or S-corporations.

- Any experience using Lunch Money, Claude AI, AI-assisted bookkeeping, or financial automation.

- The financial software and AI tools you're most comfortable using.

- Your hourly rate and weekly availability.

- Your résumé and examples of financial reports/dashboards you've created, if available.



Please begin your application with "Cash Flow First" so I know you've read the entire posting.



Short Application Exercise

1. Financial Systems & QuickBooks

You join our company and discover that our bank and credit-card accounts have not synced correctly with QuickBooks for an extended period. Transactions are missing, and our accountant needs our financial records for tax filing.

Briefly explain how you would diagnose and clean up this problem without compromising the existing bookkeeping data.

Then, tell me how you would approach creating a simpler ongoing expense-management system using Lunch Money, Claude AI, or other automation tools while ensuring the financial records remain accurate enough for our accountant.



2. Product Profitability

A customer purchases a dress for $1,200 USD. Materials cost $250, labor $180, packaging $20, shipping $35, and Shopify payment processing fees are $40.

Please tell us the total cost, gross profit, gross margin percentage, and what additional costs or information you would examine before determining the product's true profitability.



There are no trick questions. We're interested in seeing how you think, solve problems, use technology, and communicate financial information clearly.

title: Medical Scribe
description:
Virtual Medical Scribe – Optometry 



About Us

Stone Canyon Eye Care is a growing optometry group. We’re looking for detail-oriented virtual scribes to support our doctors during patient exams, so they can spend their time on patient care instead of paperwork.



The Role

You’ll join exams live over a secure video/audio connection, listen as the optometrist examines and talks with the patient, and document the visit in real time in our electronic health record system (Crystal PM). Your notes need to be accurate, complete, and finished by the end of each visit.



Responsibilities



 • Listen to patient exams live and enter the history, exam findings, assessments, and plans into the patient chart as the doctor dictates.

 • Record visual acuities, refraction measurements, eye pressures, and other clinical findings accurately.

 • Enter orders, prescriptions (glasses and contact lenses), and follow-up instructions as directed by the doctor.

 • Keep pace with a busy clinic schedule, moving quickly from one patient to the next.

 • Flag anything unclear to the doctor so charts are never left incomplete or guessed at.

 • Keep all patient information strictly confidential and follow HIPAA privacy standards.



Requirements



 • Excellent English listening, spelling, and typing skills, with the ability to understand American accents and fast speech.

 • Previous medical scribe, medical transcription, or healthcare documentation experience. Eye care or optometry experience is strongly preferred.

 • Working knowledge of medical terminology. Familiarity with eye anatomy and optometry terms is a big plus.

 • Typing speed of at least [45–60] WPM with high accuracy.

 • Reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection or power source.

Nice to Have

title: VA - Shopify, Faire, CX and Daily Operations for E-Comm Home Decor Business
description:
Business: Inner Child (e-comm home decor & accessories), 

Type: Remote 

Timezone: Prefer overlap with US Eastern (NYC time)

Start: ASAP



About Inner Child



Inner Child is a design-led home decor and accessories brand built around delightful, high-quality artisanal products—think elevated, playful, and beautiful. We sell primarily DTC on Shopify and wholesale via Faire, and we run a fast-moving operation where details matter.



We’re looking for a sharp, reliable VA to own the daily operating rhythm across Shopify, Faire, customer experience, and general e-comm operations. This role is for someone who likes clean systems, takes initiative, and can keep an online store running smoothly without being chased.



What You’ll Own (Responsibilities)

1) Shopify Operations (Daily / Weekly)



Maintain product listings: titles, descriptions, variants, pricing, tags, collections, SEO fields



Upload and organize product images; ensure images are correctly cropped/centered and consistent



Publish new products and update existing ones as inventory, packaging, or specs change



Create and QA discount codes and promotions (rules, stacking behavior, expiration)



Basic site QA: broken links, navigation issues, add-to-cart/checkout checks, out-of-stock logic



Coordinate simple theme setting updates (no heavy coding required)



2) Faire Wholesale Operations



Process wholesale orders and communicate timelines/updates to buyers



Maintain Faire catalog: listings, pricing, case packs, lead times, inventory sync logic



Handle buyer messaging (fast, friendly, professional) and resolve issues



Support sampling, new account onboarding, and re-order workflows



Prepare weekly snapshots: orders, inquiries, best-sellers, and anything that needs attention



3) Customer Experience (CX) –
 First



Respond to customer
s and DMs with a warm, premium-brand voice



Handle common requests: shipping updates, order edits, returns/exchanges, product questions



Track and escalate exceptions: lost/damaged packages, wrong items, address issues



Maintain CX macros/templates and improve them over time (faster + more consistent)



4) Daily Operations & Admin



Coordinate with 3PL/warehouse: shipment issues, inventory checks, address corrections



Create/maintain simple trackers: backorders, replacements, damaged goods, open issues



Support basic reporting: daily order count, top SKUs, low stock, returns reasons, etc.



Keep operations organized: clean documentation, checklists, and “nothing falls through cracks” follow-through



What “Great” Looks Like



You are proactive and detail-obsessed (in a good way): you spot issues before customers do



You communicate clearly and don’t let tasks linger



You’re comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with lots of small moving parts



You like building systems: templates, checklists, trackers, and repeatable workflows



You can switch between creative brand polish and operational precision



Requirements



Hands-on experience with Shopify (product setup, collections, discounts, order basics)



Experience with Faire (preferred) or wholesale marketplace workflows



Strong written English and customer-facing professionalism



Extremely organized; comfortable managing multiple workstreams and deadlines



Comfortable with Google Sheets / Excel and lightweight reporting



Bonus: Klaviyo basics, Google Merchant Center familiarity, or Shopify apps (reviews, bundles, inventory tools)



Tools We Use (or similar)



Shopify, Faire, Gmail, Google Sheets/Docs, Canva, Excel (optional: Klaviyo, Slack, project tracker like Notion/Trello/Asana)



How to Apply



Please include:



A short intro and why this role fits you



Your Shopify + Faire experience (specific examples)



Your availability (hours/week) and timezone



Your hourly rate (or monthly retainer)



A brief example of how you’d reply to this customer message:

“Hi! I ordered 6 days ago and haven’t seen tracking update. Can you help?”



Optional but appreciated: a screenshot/list of stores you’ve supported or a short Loom walkthrough of similar work



Inner Child is an equal opportunity business. We care most about excellent execution, reliability, and good judgment.

title: Lead Management & Sales Support Virtual Assistant
description:
Own the lead pipeline from first response to a booked paid consultation.



Pay: $900 USD per month for the first 90 days, then $1,000 USD per month after a successful performance review. After the first 90 days, the role becomes eligible for a $25 USD bonus per consultation booked after the first 12 booked consultations in a calendar month.



Work type: Full-time independent contractor\

Location: Remote — Philippines\

Schedule: Agreed working hours aligned with Stout Design Build’s Pacific Time business coverage



Is this you?

You communicate clearly in English, follow up without being chased, and enjoy turning a messy list of inquiries into a clean, trustworthy pipeline. You are comfortable speaking with homeowners, asking direct qualification questions, handling objections professionally, and keeping GoHighLevel (GHL) accurate.



You want real ownership—not a general virtual-assistant task list. Your lane is lead response, qualification, follow-up, consultation booking, and sales support.



 The work:

Stout Design Build creates high-end Pool and Design/Build projects in Southern California. You will own the front end of the sales process for incoming leads:



* Respond personally to new inquiries during scheduled coverage.

* Learn what the prospect wants and determine whether the project fits Stout’s services.

* Ask clear questions about location, project type, budget, timing, decision-makers, and expectations.

* Follow up consistently until the lead books, enters nurture, or closes with a documented reason.

* Explain and book Stout’s **$300 paid design consultation**.

* Keep every active lead’s stage, notes, owner, and next action current in GHL.

* Prepare complete handoffs so the sales team enters each consultation ready.

* Track fee objections and lost reasons so we can improve lead quality and follow-up.



This role is not responsible for bookkeeping, invoicing, job costing, general office administration, project administration, or field scheduling.



What success looks like:

* New inquiries receive a personal response within 2 business hours during scheduled coverage.

* 100% of active leads have a current stage, qualification notes, a named owner, and a dated next action in GHL.

* 50% of qualified leads book the $300 paid consultation.

* Aileen and the sales team can trust the pipeline without rebuilding it from texts, inboxes, or memory.



Where it goes:

Strong performance can lead to deeper ownership of GHL reporting, follow-up systems, qualification improvements, sales-support documentation, and training future support team members. Growth starts with trust, better judgment, broader sales-operations ownership, and stronger earning opportunities as the business grows.



Why Stout Design Build:

We believe in creative and practical design, flawless execution, responsibility, and doing what we say. We expect people to own mistakes, raise problems early, and avoid excuses. In this role, you shape the prospect’s first experience with our company and help the sales team focus on the right opportunities.



What we provide

* An established lead-intake script and qualification process.

* GoHighLevel (GHL) and the approved systems needed to do the work.

* Clear targets and a structured first-90-day ramp.

* Direct coaching and weekly pipeline review with Aileen Pasilan.

* Service, project, and consultation training for Pool and Design/Build leads.

* Approved communication standards and clear escalation support.



This isn’t for you if…

* You need repeated reminders to follow up.

* You avoid phone conversations or direct qualification questions.

* You guess when information is missing instead of asking or escalating.

* You let records become stale, incomplete, or unreliable.

* You apologize for the consultation fee instead of explaining its value professionally.

* You want a broad office-administration role rather than focused ownership of lead management and sales support.



How to apply:

Send your resume to 
 and a brief voice introduction explaining your experience with lead response, qualification, appointment setting, customer communication, and CRM management. Include the systems you have used and one example of how you kept a lead from going cold.

title: Experienced Real Estate Acquisition & Dispositions Manager
description:
Flip Pilot LLC is looking for a highly experienced Real Estate Acquisition & Dispositions Manager to join our team.



This is NOT an entry-level position. We need someone who already understands the complete U.S. real estate wholesaling process and can confidently manage hot seller leads from initial negotiation all the way through contract, disposition, and closing.



You will be working with daily HOT leads, so you must be comfortable speaking with motivated sellers, negotiating deals, analyzing properties, making offers, getting contracts signed, and solving problems that could prevent a transaction from closing.



Key Responsibilities:



* Handle and follow up with daily HOT seller leads.

* Speak directly with motivated property owners and build rapport.

* Negotiate purchase prices and get properties under contract.

* Analyze properties, ARV, comparable sales, repairs, and investor pricing.

* Determine appropriate cash/wholesale offers.

* Manage the acquisition process from initial conversation through signed contract.

* Disposition contracted properties to qualified cash buyers.

* Maintain and grow our investor/buyer network.

* Negotiate assignment prices and maximize deal profitability.

* Coordinate with buyers, sellers, title companies, attorneys, and other parties through closing.

* Identify closing problems early and help coordinate solutions.

* Understand common title and closing issues such as liens, judgments, probate, code violations, open permits, taxes, ownership issues, and title defects.

* Work with the appropriate title company or attorney to resolve issues that could delay or prevent closing.

* Keep sellers and buyers updated throughout the transaction.

* Follow up aggressively without losing professionalism.

* Maintain complete notes and deal stages inside our CRM.

* Manage contracts, deadlines, inspection periods, title progress, and closing dates.

* Follow up with leads that are not ready immediately and convert them over time.

* Provide daily updates on leads, contracts, dispositions, and closings.

* Be able to handle difficult sellers, buyers, negotiations, and unexpected situations independently.



Requirements:



* Proven experience in U.S. real estate wholesaling.

* Strong experience in both Acquisitions AND Dispositions.

* Must understand the complete process from seller lead → offer → contract → title → buyer → closing.

* Excellent English communication skills.

* Excellent negotiation and closing skills.

* Strong understanding of ARV, comps, repairs, and investor offers.

* Experience working with title companies and transaction-related closing problems.

* Ability to manage multiple active deals at the same time.

* Organized, dependable, and able to work independently.

* Comfortable working inside a CRM and following up consistently.

* Must be confident handling HOT leads — we do not want someone who needs to be trained from the beginning.



Schedule: Approximately 4 hours per day / 20 hours per week to start. Hours and responsibilities are expected to increase as our deal volume grows.



We are looking for someone who wants a long-term position and can become an important part of our acquisitions and dispositions operation.

title: OPERATIONS MANAGER – CLIENT RETENTION & BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT
description:
OPERATIONS MANAGER – CLIENT RETENTION & BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT

ScrubEase | Commercial Cleaning & Facility Maintenance | Full-Time | Remote



ABOUT SCRUBEASE

ScrubEase is a U.S. commercial cleaning and facility maintenance company serving clients in all 50 states, including offices, medical facilities, warehouses, schools and retail centers. ScrubEase was named Best Full-Service Cleaning Company at the 2025 BUILD FM Awards. 



POSITION SUMMARY



Note: Exclusive position: candidates may not hold other employment or freelance clients while on contract with ScrubEase.



ScrubEase is seeking an experienced Operations Manager to oversee day-to-day operations, manage client accounts, lead technician recruitment and drive new business through outbound sales. This position reports directly to the Executive Director.

A significant portion of this role is dedicated to business development. The Operations Manager is expected to resolve operational issues promptly, maintain strong client relationships and build a consistent sales pipeline. The expectation is a minimum of two new client accounts per month.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Client Retention and Account Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for client accounts by phone and

Resolve complaints and service issues promptly and professionally, including coordinating re-cleans under our 24-hour satisfaction guarantee

Conduct monthly check-in calls with every account, and review service reports to identify and address issues early

Monitor client retention and act on at-risk accounts

Maintain accurate account records, service requirements and client preferences



Sales and Business Development

Make daily outbound calls to property managers, facility managers, medical offices and multi-location businesses

Research and build targeted prospect lists

Respond promptly to all inbound calls, leads and prospect
s

Qualify prospects, gather facility details, prepare quotes and follow up through to a decision

Close new accounts and coordinate contract signing and onboarding

Offer additional services to existing clients, including floor care, carpet cleaning, pressure washing, day porter, post-construction cleaning and lawn care

Identify and prepare bids for government, school and commercial cleaning contracts, and register ScrubEase as an approved vendor with property and facility management companies

Request referrals and online reviews from satisfied clients

Record all calls, leads and quotes in company systems



Recruitment and Staffing

Recruit, screen, interview and hire cleaning technicians for new and existing accounts nationwide

Onboard technicians with site access details, job requirements and service standards

Maintain a pool of trained backup technicians to ensure uninterrupted coverage

Manage call-outs and arrange replacements



Operations and Reporting

Monitor daily service delivery and resolve issues as they arise

Ensure all scheduled jobs are completed to standard

Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs)

Provide daily and weekly reports to the Executive Director on accounts, issues, sales activity and results



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

Activity and response targets apply from week two, and results targets from month three. Call and prospecting targets are measured weekly.



Sales (minimum / target)

Outbound calls: 400 / 500 per week (approximately 80 / 100 per day)

New researched prospects: 150 / 200 per week, each with a named decision-maker and contact details

Decision-maker conversations: 80 / 120 per month

Quote opportunities (a decision-maker agrees to receive a quote): 8 / 10 per month

Quote win rate: 25% / 30%

New recurring accounts from own prospecting: 5 / 8 per quarter, or 1 / 2 per month (inbound closes counted separately)

Quotes sent within 1 hour of receiving facility details during working hours

Qualified inbound leads closed: 30% or more



Client Retention

Monthly check-in call with every account

A resolution plan agreed with the client within the same shift for every complaint

No accounts lost to avoidable service failures



Operations and Staffing

All service issues resolved or escalated within the shift

All call-outs covered, or the client notified, before the scheduled start time

All new accounts fully staffed and onboarded before their start date

A trained backup technician in every active market



Responsiveness and Reporting

First response to every lead, client message and service issue within 5 minutes during working hours

Daily end-of-shift update and a written weekly report every Friday



FIRST 90 DAYS

Month 1: Complete training on our services, pricing, systems and client accounts. Take over client communication and service issues, and reach 80 outbound calls per day by week two.

Month 2: Assume full responsibility for accounts, recruitment and staffing, and close the first new account.

Month 3: Meet all performance expectations.

A written scorecard with weekly and monthly targets is provided on the first day. The first 90 days are a probationary period. Successful completion requires meeting these milestones, including at least three new accounts from own prospecting, and raises the base salary to $1,000 per month.



QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Business Development, Marketing, Sales or a related field; Master's degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred

5+ years of experience in operations, account management or sales, including at least 2 years in a management role and 2 years working with U.S. clients

Proven operations management experience, including managing frontline or field teams and improving processes

Proven B2B outbound sales experience with a documented record of meeting targets

Demonstrated success in client retention and escalation management

Experience recruiting and hiring frontline or field staff

Excellent written and spoken English, with confident and professional phone communication with U.S. business owners and facility managers

Results-oriented and persistent in follow-up, with resilience in outbound sales

Ability to learn new services, pricing and software quickly and to work independently with minimal supervision

Proven ability to make sound, independent decisions in time-sensitive client and staffing situations

Proficiency with CRM software and spreadsheets

Commercial cleaning, janitorial or facility services experience strongly preferred



SCHEDULE AND AVAILABILITY

Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, during U.S. business hours (Central Time), which is a night shift in the Philippines

Online and reachable throughout the shift

Exclusive position: candidates may not hold other employment or freelance clients

Availability outside regular hours, including weekends, is required when business needs arise, such as recruiting and onboarding a technician for a Monday start or supporting a new account that begins on a weekend

A quiet workspace, reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection, and backup power



COMPENSATION

$800 per month base salary during a 90-day probationary period, increasing to $1,000 per month after successful completion

Uncapped monthly commission on new accounts and additional services sold. At the minimum target of two new accounts a month, commission can build to about $700 per month within six months and about $1,400 per month within a year, on top of base salary.

Long-term position with opportunities for growth



HIRING PROCESS

Application review

Written assessment by
 covering client, sales, staffing and decision-making scenarios

Video interview with Executive Director, including a sales call role-play

Paid case assignment and final interview with the Executive Director and Director of Operations



HOW TO APPLY

Please submit all of the following. Incomplete applications will not be considered.



Resume

A 2-minute introduction video describing your most significant sales win or client retention success



Answers to the following questions:



- Which degrees do you hold, and from which institutions?

- Is the stated compensation acceptable to you? Our salaries are fixed and non-negotiable.



Your application

title: Product Tester Recruitment Specialist
description:
# Product Tester Recruitment Specialist – $200 Base + $10 Per Completed Participant



We are looking for a motivated and resourceful person to help us build a network of **500+ U.S.-based product testers** for our growing e-commerce brands.



Your job will be to find real consumers who are interested in trying our products and providing genuine feedback about their experience.



## Compensation



**$200/month guaranteed base pay**



**PLUS $10 for every qualified participant you recruit who successfully completes the full product-testing and feedback process.**



You are not paid simply for submitting someone's information.



Your $10 commission is earned after the participant:



- Submits their completed private feedback



There is no limit to how many qualified participants you can recruit.



Example earnings:



100 completed participants = **$1,000 commission + $200 base**



250 completed participants = **$2,500 commission + $200 base**



500 completed participants = **$5,000 commission + $200 base**



## Participant Compensation



Approved participants may receive **$20 for completing the required product-testing and private-feedback process.**



The $20 payment is for their time participating in the product-testing program and providing feedback.



Participants are not paid or rewarded for posting Amazon reviews, and posting an Amazon review is not required to receive compensation.



## Your Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



- Finding real U.S.-based consumers interested in testing products

- Recruiting participants through social media, outreach, referrals, online communities, and other legitimate sources

- Explaining the opportunity clearly

- Making sure participants meet our qualification requirements

- Keeping an organized list of all participants

- Following up with participants throughout the process

- Making sure participants actually complete the testing and feedback requirements

- Avoiding fake, duplicate, or fraudulent participants

- Helping us build a database of at least **500+ qualified consumers**



## Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who:



- Is excellent at online research and outreach

- Knows how to find people through
, Instagram, TikTok, Reddit, online communities, referrals, and other channels

- Has experience with recruiting, lead generation, influencer outreach, market research, or community building

- Can communicate professionally

- Is organized and reliable

- Can manage spreadsheets and participant information

- Can consistently follow up with people

- Is highly motivated by performance-based compensation

- Can recruit participants at scale



Experience with Amazon, e-commerce, beauty, skincare, supplements, consumer products, or market research is a plus.



## Long-Term Opportunity



This can become a long-term position.



We are building multiple consumer brands and will continuously need product testers for new products.



Someone who can consistently recruit large numbers of legitimate participants could work with us on an ongoing basis.



Our initial goal is to build a community of **500+ active product testers**, with the potential to grow significantly beyond that.



## How to Apply



Please answer the following questions:



1. Tell us briefly about yourself.

2. Have you done recruiting, lead generation, outreach, influencer outreach, or similar work before?

**Pay: $200/month base + $10 for every qualified participant who completes the full product-testing and private-feedback process.**



We are looking for someone who can start immediately.

This role closes both gaps: one person who owns how our apps feel, makes sure the details land in the build, and brings evidenced proposals into the roadmap rather than waiting to be handed tickets.



**You'd Be a Fit If You Have:**



- 2+ years of UX or product design experience on shipped iOS and Android apps, ideally consumer-facing

- A portfolio showing mobile flows end to end: problem, research, wireframes, prototypes, and the shipped result

- Strong Figma skills: components, auto layout, variants, interactive prototypes, and clean developer handoff

- Working knowledge of Apple Human Interface Guidelines and Material Design, and the judgment to know when to follow them and when to bend them

- Experience working directly with developers: writing clear specs, answering questions fast, and reviewing builds against designs

- Comfort running lightweight usability tests and turning findings into concrete changes

- A feel for accessibility: contrast, touch targets, dynamic type, screen readers

- The judgment to design for uncertainty - communicating confidence, incompleteness, and failure honestly in an AI product

- Strong written and spoken English, and the ability to work reliable overlap hours with a US team

- A strong bias for speed and urgency, paired with high attention to detail



**Nice to Have:**



- Experience designing companion apps for connected or Bluetooth hardware (earbuds, wearables, smart devices)

- Experience with design systems or building component libraries

- Fluency with AI features in Figma - Figma Make, AI-assisted component and variant generation, prompt-driven prototyping - and a view on where they speed real work up and where they don't

- Basic front-end or React Native familiarity, enough to talk implementation trade-offs with engineers

- Motion and micro-interaction design (Figma prototyping, Lottie, Principle)



**Key Responsibilities:**



- **Own the Mobile Experience:** Design and refine user flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity screens across Raycon's mobile apps, keeping every experience approachable and easy to use

- **Own Feature Direction:** Hold an argued, evidenced point of view on where our app experience is strong and where it has fallen behind. Turn it into prioritized proposals and raise them into the roadmap. We want a position, supported by evidence, not a backlog of preferences

- **Partner with Developers:** Deliver clear, build-ready specs and Figma handoff. Sit close to engineering, answer questions quickly, and review builds to catch UX gaps before release

- **Partner with Designers:** Work with our product and brand designers so the apps look and feel unmistakably Raycon, and contribute to a shared mobile component library

- **Own the Mobile Design System:** Maintain the shared component library across Raycon apps, keeping it coherent as the portfolio consolidates

- **Design Every State:** Onboarding, pairing, empty, loading, error, offline, and permission states. On a hardware product these are the experience, not edge cases

- **Test and Iterate:** Run quick usability tests, review app store reviews and support tickets, and turn what customers struggle with into prioritized fixes

- **Raise the Standard:** Benchmark against industry-leading consumer apps, apply platform best practices, and champion accessibility and simplicity in every review



**A Day in the Life:** Sample projects may include the below.



- Redesigning first-time pairing so a new customer connects in under a minute without reading instructions

- Designing the "transfer interrupted" and "storage full" states that engineering flagged as missing

- Reviewing a TestFlight build side by side with Figma and logging the gaps for developers

- Running five quick usability sessions on a new settings screen and simplifying it based on what you saw

- Turning a cluster of one-star reviews into a specific UX fix and shipping it with engineering



**What Success Looks Like:**



- Core flows (onboarding, pairing, key features) are measurably faster and simpler, with fewer drop-offs

- App store ratings and review sentiment on usability improve release over release

- Developers get build-ready specs the first time, with fewer back-and-forth cycles and fewer UX bugs in QA

- Every screen has its unhappy states designed, so customers never land in a dead end

- A shared mobile component library is in use across Raycon apps



**Why Work at Raycon:**



- Impact: Your work is what 5M+ customers see and touch every day

- Autonomy: Own the mobile UX with real decision-making power

- Team: Grounded, ambitious, and kind coworkers who get sh*t done



**Company Values:**



- Customer First

- Think Big

- Raise the Bar Every Day

- GSD: Get Sh*t Done



**What to Expect in the Process:**



1. Hiring Manager Interview: A deeper dive into your portfolio and prior experience, aligning on vision, values, and impact

2. Case Study: A practical mobile UX exercise designed to highlight how you think and create

3. Leadership Chat: A conversation with our senior Product leader and Brand leader to align on expectations and growth

title: Staffing Operations Specialist
description:
We're looking for a Staffing Operations Specialist to join an early-stage security technology startup as their first offshore operations hire.



This company uses technology to make it easier for businesses to access and manage security services. This role will help make sure staffing requests are handled quickly, shifts are fulfilled, and both workers and clients have the support they need.



This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working with people, solving problems, and moving quickly. You'll manage daily staffing operations, coordinate workers and schedules, support clients, and help keep operations running smoothly.



As their first offshore operations hire, you'll have a lot of ownership and a direct impact on the overall business. You'll be trained on their systems and processes, but you'll also be expected to take initiative, make decisions, work independently, and take things and run with them.



What You'll Do

- Manage daily staffing operations, including schedules, shift fulfillment, and last-minute coverage.

- Coordinate with workers and partners to make sure staffing requests are fulfilled accurately and on time.

- Communicate with workers to coordinate shifts, answer questions, and resolve issues.

- Communicate with clients about staffing needs, schedule changes, and operational issues.

- Help onboard new workers and ensure they are ready for their assignments.

- Monitor daily operations and quickly address issues as they come up.

- Manage internal communications and make sure important information gets to the right people quickly.

- Identify operational problems and find practical ways to improve processes.

- Give feedback to the product and engineering team when something isn't working or could be improved.

- Use Claude Code, Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI tools to solve problems, improve workflows, and work more efficiently.

- Take on different responsibilities as the company grows.



What We're Looking For 

- 2+ years of experience in staffing, workforce management, or operations, ideally in a fast-paced environment.

- Experience coordinating shifts, schedules, workers, or real-time staffing needs.

- Experience working with U.S.-based clients, workers, or operations is highly preferred.

- Previous startup experience is a strong plus.

- Comfortable communicating directly with both clients and workers.

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to handle issues quickly as they come up.

- Able to work independently, take ownership, and make decisions without needing constant direction.

- Flexible and comfortable taking on different types of work as priorities change.

- Hands-on experience using AI tools such as Claude Code, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar tools to solve problems, improve workflows, or automate tasks.

- Comfortable learning new systems and working with technology.

- Willing to speak up, share ideas, and give feedback when something isn't working.

- Security industry or other shift-based staffing experience is a plus, but not required.

- Must be available to work U.S. time zones.

- Reliable internet connection and a dedicated WFH setup required.



Salary and Benefits

Base salary: 65,000 PHP per month

Paid Time Off + Paid Holidays

100% WFH

Application Instructions

Please send your resume link using a publicly accessible PDF from Google Drive. Make sure it is a direct file link (not a folder or Google Doc).

Links from Dropbox, OneDrive, OnlineJobs, or other similar platforms, as well as non-direct file links, may not be reviewed by our Talent Team.

Please also include:

- A short explanation of why you're a good fit for the role

- Copy and paste this Job ID: recbFAEpHDAKPdKSh and include it in your
 subject line

- Include this message in your
 body: "I'm excited to be applying to Job recbFAEpHDAKPdKSh!"



This will help us identify your application quickly and also shows that you’ve read the entire job description (attention to detail is important for this role). Thanks and hope to hear from you soon!

title: UGC & Short-Form Ad Editor for TikTok/Reels - Grow Into Your Own Brand
description:
If you want to grow fast as an editor, work with one of the kindest, most fun teams out there, and have real potential to earn big down the line, this could be the best job you'll ever have as an editor.





📌 Previous professional experience required. You must attach examples of your previous work (Google Drive link, public access, or similar). Applications without samples will not be processed.



👋 About Us

We are a fast-growing e-commerce company producing short-form ads for TikTok, Instagram, and
. We test fast, learn from every ad, and improve every week. We're a tight-knit team, more like a family than a company, with strong connections between everyone and a genuinely great group to be part of.



🎯 The Role

This is your entry point into the Westros team. You will edit short-form video ads for the products we launch, based on detailed briefs from our Creative Strategists. Your job is to execute the brief precisely while making the videos as relatable, native, and scroll-stopping as possible.



We need someone who thinks beyond just cutting clips. You understand why an ad performs or flops, you spot weak hooks before they go live, and you constantly look for ways to make the next version better.



✅ What You Will Do



Receive detailed creative briefs from our Creative Strategists and execute them precisely

Edit short-form video ads for the products we launch across TikTok, Reels, and
 Ads

Build videos that feel native and relatable, not like polished commercials

Craft hooks that stop the scroll in the first 1-2 seconds

Add text, captions, sound effects, transitions, and graphics that lift performance

Help analyze what made winning ads win, and apply those learnings to the next round



🙋 You Are a Good Fit If You



Have proven experience editing short-form social ads (TikTok / Reels / FB ads)

Follow briefs and instructions precisely, every time

Understand why an ad works: hooks, pacing, retention, emotional triggers

Build videos that feel like a real person made them

Work fast, independently, and hit deadlines

Take feedback well and treat every revision as a chance to improve

Comfortable with or willing to learn: 
, Vmake, ElevenLabs, Notion, and your preferred editing software



💰 What We Offer



Base fee: $300/month

Fully remote, flexible hours ⏰

Steady, long-term volume (not one-off gigs)

🎓 Free access to a professional video editing course worth $9,000

📈 You will learn more here than at any other job, we promise. This is real, hands-on experience with fast-moving brands, not busywork

🚀 This is where the real money is made: top performers get the opportunity to take over an entire brand, partnering with one of our Creative Strategists and us to run it, sharing in the profit. We handle building and running the store, you and your strategist partner own the creative direction

A creative team where your work directly impacts results



📋 Details

Type: Part-time or Full-time

Setup: Fully remote

Start: ASAP 🔥



📩 Interested? Apply here with your portfolio, and we'll follow up directly.

title: Credentialing Specialist
description:
Role: Credentialing Specialist 

Location: Remote

Industry: Healthcare Staffing

Compensation: $550 base pay + commission ($15 for every fully credentialed healthcare professional)

Shift: 9am - 6pm EST; Wednesday to Sunday (Monday & Tuesday OFF)



About the Role



We are seeking a Credentialing Specialist with a strong sales mindset to join our healthcare staffing team. This role goes beyond traditional credentialing, you will actively engage, motivate commitment from, and guide healthcare professionals to complete and submit their credentials so their profiles are fully prepared for job submission.

If you are confident, consultative in your approach, and effective at moving conversations into action, this role is for you.



Key Responsibilities



Proactively contact healthcare professionals (nurses, allied health, and other clinicians) to obtain required credentialing documents

Use sales techniques and consultative communication to explain the value of credentialing and motivate candidates to complete their profiles

Overcome objections and hesitation by clearly communicating how credentialing leads to job opportunities and faster placement

Build rapport and trust with candidates to ensure long-term engagement

Follow up consistently via phone,
, and text until credentialing is complete

Ensure all credentials meet compliance and client requirements

Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in internal systems

Collaborate with recruiters to prioritize high-demand candidates and urgent submissions



Required Qualifications:



Strong sales or customer-facing background (inside sales, account management, recruiting, or similar roles)

Proven ability to gain buy-in, influence, and close

Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Comfortable making high-volume outbound calls and follow-ups

Highly organized with strong attention to detail

Ability to manage multiple candidates and deadlines simultaneously

Self-motivated, resilient, and results-driven



Preferred Qualifications:



Experience in healthcare staffing, credentialing, recruiting, or compliance

Familiarity with healthcare credentials (licenses, certifications, immunizations, background checks, etc.)

CRM or ATS experience



What Success Looks Like:



Candidates complete credentialing quickly and accurately

High response and conversion rates from outreach

Strong relationships with healthcare professionals

Increased speed and success of job submissions



Why Join Us



Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives

Opportunity to combine sales skills with healthcare impact

Fast-paced, supportive team environment

Career growth within healthcare staffing and recruitment

title: Social Media, Influencer & Email Marketing Manager
description:
This is a full-time position.  We pay well, and we do not allow anyone to take on an additional client (moonlighting) while working with us.  



Company: Southshore Fine Linens

Location: Las Vegas, NV / Remote

Position: Full-Time



About the Role



Southshore Fine Linens is looking for a hands-on, results-driven Social Media, Influencer &
 Marketing Manager to own and grow our social media presence, influencer/creator program,
 marketing, and the connection between these channels and our Shopify store.



This is not simply a content-posting position. We are looking for someone who understands how social media, influencers,
, and Shopify work together to generate traffic, customer acquisition, conversions, and revenue for an e-commerce brand.



The ideal candidate must have hands-on experience with:



TikTok and TikTok Shop

Instagram


Pinterest

X (formerly
)

Influencer and creator management

Omnisend

Shopify

Social Media Management



Own the strategy, execution, growth, and day-to-day management of Southshore Fine Linens across TikTok, Instagram,
, Pinterest, and X.



Responsibilities include:



Develop and manage the overall social media calendar.

Create platform-specific strategies rather than simply posting identical content everywhere.

Coordinate and publish Reels, Stories, posts, videos, Pins, promotional content, and other creative.

Develop content around products, promotions, launches, seasonal events, lifestyle topics, customer reviews, educational topics, and trends.

Write compelling captions, hooks, calls-to-action, and social copy.

Monitor comments, messages, mentions, and customer engagement.

Identify emerging trends and act quickly on relevant opportunities.

Repurpose successful content intelligently across platforms.

Test creative concepts, hooks, formats, posting schedules, and calls-to-action.

Grow followers and engagement while maintaining our brand voice.

Drive qualified traffic from social media to our Shopify store.

Track traffic, conversions, and revenue generated by social media.

TikTok & TikTok Shop



Candidate must understand TikTok inside and out, including:



Organic TikTok strategy

TikTok Shop

TikTok Creator and Affiliate programs

Creator outreach and recruitment

UGC content

Product seeding

Short-form video strategy

Trends, sounds, hooks, and formats

Creator commissions

Product promotions

Campaign development

TikTok analytics

Traffic and conversion tracking



The candidate should understand how to identify content with strong potential, recruit creators, develop campaigns, and turn TikTok activity into measurable sales.



Instagram,
, Pinterest & X



The candidate will be responsible for developing and executing strategies specific to each platform.



Instagram: Reels, Stories, feed posts, carousels, UGC, influencer collaborations, product content, engagement, and community building.



: Organic content, Reels, promotions, customer engagement, product content, seasonal campaigns, and coordination with Instagram and the Meta ecosystem.



Pinterest: Pins, boards, keyword optimization, Pinterest search, seasonal and evergreen content, product discovery, Shopify traffic, and conversion tracking.



X: Brand communications, product announcements, promotional content, customer engagement, relevant conversations, and timely brand messaging.



The candidate should understand that each platform requires its own audience strategy, content style, and objectives.



Influencer & Creator Management



Own and grow our influencer and creator program across social platforms.



Responsibilities include:



Identify and recruit influencers and creators who align with Southshore Fine Linens.

Conduct influencer outreach.

Negotiate collaborations, compensation, commissions, affiliate arrangements, and deliverables.

Manage creators from initial outreach through campaign completion.

Coordinate product samples and gifting.

Develop creator briefs and content requirements.

Track products sent to influencers.

Track posting deadlines and deliverables.

Manage affiliate links and promotional codes.

Monitor creator-generated traffic and sales.

Maintain an organized influencer/creator database.

Develop longer-term partnerships with high-performing creators.

Measure influencer performance based on engagement, traffic, conversions, sales, and ROI.



We want someone who understands that follower count alone does not determine the value of an influencer. The goal is to identify creators who can produce great content, reach the right customers, and influence purchasing behavior.



Omnisend &
 Marketing



Candidate must have hands-on Omnisend experience.



Responsibilities include:



Build and schedule
 campaigns.

Create promotional, product-launch, seasonal, and retention campaigns.

Build and optimize automated
 flows.

Segment customers based on purchasing and engagement behavior.

Maintain subscriber lists and list hygiene.

Grow the
 subscriber database.

Conduct A/B testing.

Optimize subject lines, offers, creative, calls-to-action, and send times.

Track
 traffic through Shopify.

Monitor conversions and revenue generated from
.

 Deliverability



Candidate must understand
 deliverability and sender reputation, including:



Greenlisting/whitelisting
 addresses and domains

SPF

DKIM

DMARC

Sender reputation

Spam complaints

Bounce rates

Inbox placement

Suppression lists

List hygiene

 authentication

Deliverability troubleshooting



The candidate should be able to identify potential deliverability problems and take appropriate steps to improve inbox placement.



Shopify & E-Commerce



Hands-on Shopify experience is required.



The candidate does not need to be a Shopify developer, but must be comfortable working inside Shopify and understand how marketing activity translates into e-commerce results.



Responsibilities and required knowledge include:



Navigate and manage the Shopify backend.

Understand products, collections, pages, navigation, and promotions.

Create and update landing pages as needed for campaigns.

Create and manage discount codes and promotional offers.

Understand Shopify customer data and segmentation.

Understand Shopify analytics and reporting.

Track traffic sources, conversions, average order value, and revenue.

Understand conversion rate and the customer purchase funnel.

Connect social campaigns to appropriate products, collections, and landing pages.

Understand integrations between Shopify, Omnisend, TikTok, Meta, Pinterest, and other marketing platforms.

Use UTMs and other tracking methods to properly attribute traffic and sales.

Review campaign performance based on actual Shopify revenue—not simply clicks and engagement.

Identify basic website or product-page issues that may be hurting conversion.

Work with other team members to improve product pages, promotions, landing pages, and customer experience.



The candidate should understand the entire customer journey:



Social/Influencer/Email → Shopify → Product Page → Add to Cart → Checkout → Purchase → Repeat Customer



Reporting & KPIs



This position will be accountable for measurable business results—not simply posting activity.



Key performance indicators will include:



Social media reach and engagement

Audience/follower growth

Video views and watch time

Website traffic from social media

Shopify sessions by marketing channel

Conversion rate

Revenue attributable to social media

TikTok Shop sales

Influencer-generated revenue

Creator conversion rates

Influencer campaign ROI

Pinterest-generated traffic

 list growth

 click-through rate

 conversion rate

-generated revenue

 deliverability

Shopify conversion rate

Average order value

New vs. returning customers

Revenue by channel



The candidate should provide regular reporting that clearly explains:



What happened?

What worked?

What didn't work?

Why?

What are we going to change or test next?



Required Experience

Demonstrated experience managing social media for an e-commerce or consumer brand.

Advanced TikTok knowledge is required.

Experience with TikTok Shop.

Experience managing Instagram,
, Pinterest, and X.

Experience managing influencers, creators, affiliates, and UGC campaigns.

Hands-on Omnisend experience is required.

Hands-on Shopify experience is required.

Knowledge of
 deliverability and greenlisting/whitelisting.

Understanding of Shopify analytics, conversions, promotions, and customer behavior.

Strong understanding of short-form video.

Strong copywriting skills.

Strong organizational and follow-up skills.

Ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.

Comfortable analyzing marketing data and reporting results.

Strong understanding of e-commerce conversion and customer acquisition.

Ability to work independently and take ownership of results.

What We're Looking For



We want someone who is proactive, creative, organized, accountable, analytical, and commercially minded.



You should not need to be told every day what to post or whom to contact. We expect you to actively look for trends, creators, content opportunities, and new ways to generate traffic and revenue.



You should be able to come to the team every week and say:



“Here is what happened last week, here is what worked, here is what didn't work, and here is what I recommend we do next.”



Application Requirements



Please provide the following with your application:



Social media accounts you have personally managed.

Examples of TikTok content and campaigns you personally managed.

Your experience with TikTok Shop.

Your experience with Instagram,
, Pinterest, and X.

Examples of influencer/creator campaigns you personally managed.

Your experience with Omnisend.

Your experience with
 deliverability and greenlisting/whitelisting.

Your experience managing Shopify stores.

Examples of Shopify campaigns, landing pages, promotions, or discount strategies you have managed.

Examples of measurable results you achieved, including traffic, conversions, sales, and ROI.

The KPIs you believe an e-commerce brand should review every week.



Please do not apply if your social media experience is primarily limited to creating graphics, scheduling posts, or increasing follower counts.



We are looking for someone who understands social media, influencers,
, Shopify, and e-commerce as interconnected revenue-generating functions.

title: CapCut Video Editor — Sound Effects & Animation Only (Street Interview Reels, Long-term)
description:
I run a Korean street-interview Reels channel (Seoul, Korean/English). Cutting and bilingual captions are completed in-house — you handle only the finishing layer.



Scope



Sound effects placed on the right beats

Caption/keyword animations and zoom punch-ins on reactions

Stickers/emphasis moments where appropriate

Match the benchmark style precisely — not your personal style

Benchmarks (study before applying)




/mojiverse


/thej2way_





CapCut desktop project zip — source video, all cuts, and KR/EN captions already placed; opens in your CapCut with the included one-click installer

Benchmark reel links for that video's tone

A short style note (dos/don'ts)

Timestamped feedback on each revision round

You deliver: finished CapCut project + exported MP4 (1080×1920).



Terms



$2-3 per minute of final video (typical video: 1–3 min). Several videos per week, long-term for the right person.

Turnaround: within 24 hours per video

We begin with one trial video before we make the contract.





Requirements



CapCut desktop (PC) — mobile-only editors will not be considered(we will offer you the pro version)

Proven short-form work where you personally added SFX/animation

To apply — answer all of the following (incomplete applications are not reviewed):





1. 3 links of the bestshort-form videos you edited — state exactly which elements (SFX, animation, zooms) were yours. Please dont upload your whole portfolio but upload your 3 best edited video links.

2. Watch any recent reel 
 in 2–3 sentences, describe its SFX/zoom pattern and how you would replicate it.

3. CapCut desktop version you use, and your PC specs.

4. Delivery time for a 2-minute video after receiving the project.

5. Weekly capacity (videos/week) and your time zone

title: Executive Assistant to the Founder
description:
TERVELL | A better way to compete for government work



About TERVELL

TERVELL works with established construction, civil, trade and specialist contractors competing for government and major-project work. We strengthen the commercial capability and capacity behind how they compete, bringing additional expertise alongside the business where it is needed.



The business is currently undergoing a shift and moving in a new direction. It's an exciting time to be involved, and I'm looking for someone who is committed to being accountable, taking responsibility and keeping me on track.



I have high standards for the work we deliver and the way we look after our clients. The EA role exists to protect my time, keep the business moving and make sure client commitments don't fall through the cracks.



As a professional services business, my personal and business reputation matters. That means attention to detail, timeliness and professionalism in dealing with our clients, as well as being organised enough to see what needs doing and resourceful enough to work things out.



The role

This role replaces an administrative assistant position because I now need a higher level of ownership, judgement and accountability as TERVELL grows.



I'm looking for my operational right hand as TERVELL continues to grow and evolve. I want to be able to step away from the day-to-day administration knowing it's in great hands and trusting that any issues that genuinely require my attention will be escalated to me.



I need someone who is organised and focused, who can kick things off by reviewing the administrative practices currently in place, organising what is here and continuing to improve TERVELL's systems. You'll run the inboxes, calendar and follow-ups; produce and format client documents to brand; operate the invoicing process end to end; and own the operating rhythm around me.



You are responsible for knowing what is outstanding, what is due and what needs attention across my workload, clients and active engagements. I should not need to identify overdue actions or remind you of agreed priorities.



The person who succeeds here anticipates rather than waits, gets numbers and formatting exactly right, and has the judgement to know what to handle and what to escalate.



Key responsibilities

- Executive support - manage the inboxes and calendar, screen and prioritise, prepare for meetings, capture and chase actions, arrange travel, and protect focus time.

- Client and engagement coordination - act as a first point of contact for scheduling and routine client liaison, handle engagement onboarding admin, and own the administrative rhythm of active engagements. Proactively identify outstanding client-facing actions, follow-ups and deadlines, and make sure they are completed. 
 is the control tool, not the job itself.

- Document production - format proposals, reports and client deliverables to TERVELL brand standards, manage versions, and run final-output checks including fonts, spelling, hyperlinks and clean markup before anything is sent.

- Invoicing and finance admin - operate the client invoicing process in Xero to a documented procedure: draft invoices from accepted terms, complete pre-submission checks, issue on approval, and send payment reminders. The role executes agreed terms and escalates anything commercial; it does not make or infer commercial decisions.

- Operations support - maintain file discipline and SOPs, administer the core tools including Xero, 
, Google Workspace, Slack and GoHighLevel, and improve the small systems that keep the business running.



What I'm looking for

- Anticipates needs and takes ownership - moves without waiting to be told and closes loops.

- Strong prioritisation judgement - understands that client commitments and time-sensitive actions take precedence over lower-value internal administration without needing me to continually reset priorities.

- High accuracy under pressure, especially with numbers, figures and document formatting.

- Strong written English and correct Australian spelling and usage.

- Discretion and confidentiality - you will handle client commercial and financial information.

- Confident across Xero, 
 and Google Workspace, and quick to learn new tools.

- Sound judgement about the escalation line - knows what to resolve and what to hand up.

- Calm and organised across competing priorities in a small business where things change quickly.

- I'm not adverse to the use of AI and use it extensively myself. However, I expect you to apply your own judgement to anything it produces. Outputs must be checked for accuracy, relevance and duplication and make sense in the context of how the business actually operates.



Well regarded

- Experience supporting a founder, director or small professional-services firm.

- Exposure to invoicing or bookkeeping in Xero.

- Familiarity with tenders, procurement, accreditation or compliance work.



Practical details

- Part-time.

- Offshore contractor.

- Core working hours commence at 8:30am AEST.

- Reporting directly to the Founder.

- Hourly rate dependent on experience and capability.



To apply

Please provide:

- A short introduction telling me why this role interests you and the kind of founder or business you've supported previously.

title: Long-Form YouTube Video Editor – Travel & Lifestyle

We are established travel and lifestyle content creators with nearly 1 million combined subscribers and followers across multiple platforms. We are hiring a full-time long-form YouTube editor for our creator-led travel, RV, van-life, outdoor, and adventure channel.



Our finished videos are generally 20–45 minutes long. We need an experienced editor who can turn several hours of raw footage into a compelling, story-driven YouTube video—not simply arrange clips in chronological order.



This position is focused on long-form YouTube content, not Shorts, Reels, podcasts, gaming videos, or corporate content.



ABOUT THE EDITING STYLE



A strong style reference for this position is Trent the Traveler.



Before applying, watch several of his long-form YouTube videos and become familiar with his storytelling, pacing, dialogue editing, music selection, sound design, scenic sequences, humor, and emotional timing.



We need an editor who can:



• Find the strongest story within several hours of raw footage

• Create compelling openings that immediately build curiosity

• Structure each video with a clear beginning, middle, and end

• Edit natural conversations without making them feel rushed

• Remove repetitive, unnecessary, or weak footage

• Use music, sound effects, B-roll, and scenic footage effectively

• Build anticipation and maintain viewer interest

• Know when an edit should move quickly and when a 
nt should breathe

ENGLISH FLUENCY IS REQUIRED



You must be highly fluent in spoken and written English.



Our videos include natural conversations, humor, sarcasm, reactions, emotional 
nts, and storylines that develop throughout the footage. You must understand the dialogue, tone, and context well enough to make strong decisions about pacing, cuts, music, and emotional timing.



THE ROLE



You will edit complete 20–45 minute YouTube videos from raw footage through final delivery.



You must be able to:



• Review several hours of raw footage and identify the strongest story

• Create a compelling opening and clear beginning, middle, and end

• Edit natural dialogue while preserving humor, emotion, and pacing

• Remove repetitive, unnecessary, or weak footage

• Use music, sound design, B-roll, scenic footage, and travel montages effectively

• Add text, maps, captions, and graphics when needed

• Follow editing notes, complete revisions accurately, and apply feedback consistently

• Meet deadlines, work independently, and communicate clearly

• Send a brief end-of-day email summarizing your progress and any questions



You must have proven experience editing long-form, creator-led travel, lifestyle, RV, van-life, outdoor, or adventure YouTube videos.



You must also have strong storytelling instincts, excellent attention to detail, reliable high-speed internet, a dependable editing computer, and availability for approximately 40 hours per week.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with:



I READ THE LONG-FORM VIDEO LINK REQUIREMENTS



Then include the following:



1. YOUR INFORMATION



• Full name

• Email address

• Current city and country

• Editing software and computer you use

• Expected hourly rate

• Weekly availability

• Normal working hours in Philippine Time

• Earliest available start date

• Whether you currently have another full-time job or major ongoing clients



2. YOUR TOP THREE LONG-FORM VIDEO EDITS



Provide EXACTLY THREE direct, clickable links to individual, published YouTube videos that you personally edited.



All three videos must:



• Be at least 15 minutes long

• Be creator-led travel, lifestyle, RV, van-life, outdoor, or adventure videos

• Link directly to the actual published video

• Clearly demonstrate your long-form storytelling and editing ability



At least one must be a travel, RV, or van-life vlog with storytelling, pacing, and production quality similar to Trent the Traveler’s long-form videos.



For each video, include:



• The direct YouTube link

• The channel name

• The video runtime

• Whether you edited the entire video

• What you personally edited if anyone else was involved



DO NOT SEND:



• Portfolio websites

• Demo reels

• YouTube channel homepages

• Playlists

• Google Drive or Dropbox folders

• Short-form videos

• Links that require us to search for your work



We will only review the three direct video links you submit.



Applications without exactly three qualifying direct video links will not be reviewed.

title: Video Editor
description:
**READ THIS FIRST — DO NOT APPLY WITHOUT THESE**



We are looking for a full-time editor with a proven track record editing long-form lifestyle YouTube videos in the travel/van life/adventure space.



Your editing style should match the quality and feel of channels like Trent the Traveler. If you are not familiar with Trent the Traveler's videos, go watch several of his videos on YouTube before applying. That is the editing style, pacing, and storytelling quality we expect.



You must be fluent in English. You will be editing dialogue-driven storytelling content, so you need to understand every word being said in order to nail the pacing, cuts, and emotional beats.



If you do not have experience editing this style of content or are not fluent in spoken and written English, please do not apply.



ABOUT US:

We are full-time content creators with over 800,000 subscribers and followers across multiple platforms (YouTube, Instagram,
, X/Twitter, TikTok). Our primary YouTube channel produces long-form lifestyle travel and van life content (20–45 minutes per video). We need an editor who understands this genre inside and out — the pacing, the storytelling, the emotional beats, and the way these videos hold viewers from the first second to the last.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:

You'll work with both edited and raw footage to produce finished videos that are engaging, professional, and tell a compelling story. This includes long-form YouTube videos (20–45 min) and short-form content (Shorts, Reels, TikTok under 60 sec).



You must be proficient in trimming, cutting, and arranging footage into cohesive narratives; adding transitions, music, sound effects, and visual effects; color correction and grading; text overlays, captions, and graphics; pacing and structure for both long-form and short-form content; and adapting editing style to match platform requirements (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok).



We need someone who is fast, reliable, has a natural storytelling instinct, and is passionate about creating content that pulls viewers in from the first second and keeps them watching.



TO APPLY — ALL OF THE FOLLOWING ARE REQUIRED (incomplete applications will not be reviewed):



1. Your email address.

2. The video editing software you use and the type of computer you edit on.

3. Your expected hourly rate.

4. CLICKABLE LINKS to exactly 3 long-form lifestyle/travel YouTube videos you have edited. These must be published videos on YouTube that we can watch right now. They should demonstrate your ability to edit in the style described above — think Trent the Traveler level pacing, storytelling, and production quality. If your portfolio does not reflect this style and level of editing, please do not apply.

5. Clickable links to 2 short-form video projects you have edited (Shorts, Reels, or TikTok).

6. Visit 
 and perform an internet speed test. Post your results for both upload speed and download speed.



COMPENSATION:

$5 – $8 per hour depending on experience, ~40 hours per week.



SKILLS REQUIRED:

Fluent in English (spoken and written), Long-form video editing (20–45 min YouTube videos), short-form video editing (Shorts, Reels, TikTok), high attention to detail, strong storytelling ability, creativity, and fast turnaround.

CONTENT & CANVA SUPPORT

SOCIAL MEDIA BACKUP DM & COMMENT COVERAGE

- Leaving clear handoffs for the primary Community Manager





WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You may be a great fit if:

- You genuinely enjoy making a busy person's life easier

- You are naturally proactive

- Once you understand the priorities, you look for what needs doing rather than waiting for every task to be assigned

After you have learned the role:

- Important follow-ups do not disappear

- You increasingly see the next useful thing before it has to be assigned

- Projects and administrative work keep moving without constant supervision

HOW TO APPLY

 per piece whether it should be a real person on camera, AI, or something else, and you can explain why

-

If we need 20 cleaners, your response shouldn't be:

Your response should be:

You own the recruiting funnel

Your responsibility doesn't end when somebody applies.

SOURCE → SCREEN → INTERVIEW → QUALIFY → ONBOARD → FIRST JOB / START → RETENTION
