title: Operations Coordinator
description:
# 

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented **Operations Coordinator** to help manage the day-to-day operations of a fast-growing digital marketing agency.



This role will work closely with leadership, account management, sales, and fulfillment teams to ensure clients are onboarded smoothly, invoices are sent and tracked properly, internal tasks stay organized, and nothing falls through the cracks.



This is not a basic virtual assistant position. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of operational processes, identify problems before they become issues, and help create better systems as the company grows.



## Key Responsibilities



### Client Onboarding

- Manage the onboarding process for new clients from signed contract through fulfillment handoff

- Ensure contracts, payments, intake forms, access requests, and onboarding documentation are completed

- Create client accounts, folders, Slack channels, project boards, and internal documentation

- Coordinate kickoff calls and introductions between clients and the appropriate team members

- Follow up with clients for missing information, logins, assets, or approvals

- Ensure the fulfillment team has everything required before work begins



### Billing & Invoicing

- Create and send client invoices

- Monitor outstanding invoices and payment statuses

- Follow up professionally on overdue payments

- Keep billing records organized and accurate

- Coordinate subscription changes, cancellations, upgrades, and billing adjustments

- Flag unusual payment issues or overdue accounts to leadership



### Operations & Project Coordination

- Help coordinate tasks between account managers, SEO strategists, content teams, developers, and leadership

- Track deadlines and make sure deliverables are progressing

- Follow up internally when tasks are overdue or blocked

- Maintain project management systems and ensure tasks have clear owners and deadlines

- Help manage recurring operational processes

- Identify bottlenecks and recommend ways to improve workflows



### Client Management Support

- Assist account managers with operational tasks

- Make sure client requests are documented and assigned correctly

- Track important client milestones and deliverables

- Help ensure client reports, meetings, and follow-ups happen on schedule

- Escalate client concerns when necessary

- Maintain accurate client information inside the CRM and internal systems



### Sales-to-Fulfillment Handoff

- Review newly closed deals and confirm all deal information is accurate

- Ensure pricing, scope, expectations, and special agreements are properly documented

- Coordinate handoffs between the sales team and fulfillment team

- Make sure sales commitments are clearly communicated internally

- Identify missing or unclear information before fulfillment begins



### Systems & Documentation

- Create and improve SOPs for recurring processes

- Maintain company documentation and operational checklists

- Help build automations that reduce repetitive administrative work

- Keep CRM pipelines, project management tools, and internal systems organized

- Identify opportunities to automate workflows using AI and software tools



### General Operations

- Support leadership with operational projects

- Help coordinate contractors, employees, and vendors when needed

- Assist with reporting and tracking company KPIs

- Help prepare weekly operational updates

- Take ownership of miscellaneous operational problems as they arise



## What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate is someone who:



- Is extremely organized and detail-oriented

- Takes ownership instead of waiting to be told what to do

- Is comfortable following up repeatedly when something needs to get done

- Communicates professionally with clients and team members

- Can manage multiple priorities at the same time

- Notices when something is missing or doesn't make sense

- Enjoys building systems and improving processes

- Is comfortable working in a fast-moving environment

- Can work independently with minimal supervision

- Is comfortable working directly with company leadership



## Preferred Experience



Experience with some of the following is strongly preferred:



- Digital marketing agencies

- Client onboarding

- Account management or client success

- Project management

- Invoicing and accounts receivable

- CRM management

- GoHighLevel

- ClickUp, 
, Asana, or similar project management software

- Slack

- Google Workspace

- QuickBooks, Stripe, or similar billing platforms

- Zapier, Make, or workflow automation tools

- AI tools such as ChatGPT



SEO or digital marketing knowledge is helpful but not required.



## What Success Looks Like



Within the first 90 days, we would expect this person to:



- Fully own the client onboarding process

- Ensure new clients are handed off smoothly from sales to fulfillment

- Maintain accurate invoicing and proactively follow up on outstanding payments

- Keep internal projects and client deliverables organized

- Reduce the number of tasks that leadership needs to personally follow up on

- Identify operational bottlenecks and propose solutions

- Improve or document several key SOPs

- Become a reliable central point of coordination across the company



## The Type of Person Who Will Thrive Here



You will likely succeed in this role if you're the type of person who sees something unfinished and immediately wants to close the loop.



You should be comfortable saying:



"I noticed this client still hasn't provided access, so I followed up."



"This invoice is overdue, so I've contacted the client."



"This task has been sitting for three days, so I contacted the owner."



"This process keeps creating issues, so I documented a better way to handle it."



We are looking for someone who brings structure, accountability, and organization to a fast-growing company.

About Ashoori Law



Ashoori Law is a U.S.-based immigration law firm serving individuals, families, entrepreneurs, investors, and businesses with their U.S. immigration needs.



We are seeking a highly capable Marketing Manager to oversee and execute the firm’s marketing efforts, strengthen lead generation, optimize conversion systems, and drive measurable growth.

Lead quality

title: Operations & Business Development Support
description:
**Engagement:** Part-Time  

**Hours:** 20 Hours per Week  

**Starting Rate:** $5 USD per Hour  

**Client Time Zone:** Mountain Time (MT)  

**Schedule:** Exact working hours TBD. Candidates must be willing and able to work within the client's Mountain Time operating hours.  

**Growth Potential:** This role is expected to grow in responsibility and may expand in hours as the working relationship develops.



## About the Role



Project Outsource is looking for an experienced Contractor to support an established business owner, speaker, and entrepreneur.



This is not a role for someone who simply waits for a task list.



The right person will begin by taking ownership of core executive and administrative functions, then progressively become a trusted right-hand partner who understands the client's business, communication style, priorities, systems, and relationships well enough to anticipate what needs attention.



The goal is to remove operational work from the client's plate so she can spend more of her time on speaking, creative work, relationship-building, and business growth.



The role will begin with clearly defined responsibilities and expand gradually as trust, familiarity, and capability develop.



## Initial Responsibilities



###
 & Inbox Management



- Review and organize the client's inbox.

- Filter low-priority and unnecessary
s.

- Surface messages requiring the client's attention or response.

- Maintain a clear system for priorities, follow-ups, and outstanding conversations.

- Draft responses in the client's tone and voice.

- Progress toward independently handling appropriate communications once trust and approval have been established.

- Track important conversations so opportunities and commitments do not disappear into the inbox abyss.



### Calendar & Executive Support



- Maintain and organize the client's calendar.

- Coordinate meetings and appointments.

- Identify scheduling conflicts and priorities.

- Help protect the client's time by keeping commitments organized and visible.

- Track follow-ups and action items resulting from meetings and conversations.



### Speaking Opportunity Research & Outreach



As the EVA becomes established in the role, responsibilities will expand into business-development support, including:



- Researching relevant speaking opportunities.

- Identifying conferences, podcasts, events, workshops, organizations, communities, and other appropriate platforms.

- Researching contacts and decision-makers associated with those opportunities.

- Maintaining an organized pipeline of potential opportunities.

- Conducting initial outreach using approved messaging and the client's communication style.

- Following up consistently on active opportunities.

- Tracking conversations and outcomes within the appropriate system or CRM.



**Previous experience with speaking engagement outreach, podcast guest outreach, PR outreach, lead generation, partnership development, or similar research/outbound work is highly desirable, but not required.**



Strong research skills and the ability to determine whether an opportunity is actually relevant are more important than blindly producing enormous lead lists.



### CRM & Relationship Management



- Maintain accurate contact and opportunity records.

- Track communications, follow-ups, and next steps.

- Help ensure promising relationships do not fall through the cracks.

- Maintain speaking and business-development pipelines.

- Support ongoing relationship nurturing.

- Enter and maintain lead information generated through networking and other business-development activities.



### Systems & Process Support



The EVA should become familiar with the client's existing workflows before attempting to reinvent them.



You will be expected to:



- Learn existing processes and systems.

- Document recurring workflows as you learn them.

- Identify missing steps, bottlenecks, or recurring administrative problems.

- Recommend practical improvements.

- Build repeatable systems for recurring responsibilities.

- Use automation and AI appropriately to reduce repetitive work.

- Maintain documentation so important processes do not live exclusively in someone's head.



You are not being hired to independently create the client's business strategy.



You **are** being hired to understand how the business operates, execute reliably, recognize opportunities for improvement, and gradually take greater ownership of its day-to-day operations.



## Technology & Tools



The client's current and anticipated technology stack includes:



- **
** – project and workflow management

- **Streak CRM** –
-based CRM and opportunity tracking

- **Google Workspace /
 & Calendar tools**

- **Slack** – ongoing communication and collaboration

- **Zoom** – meetings and direct communication

- **Claude and other AI tools** – research, communication assistance, workflow support, and automation

- Other CRM, automation, research, and productivity tools as required



Previous experience with **
 and/or Streak CRM is preferred but not required.**



We care more about whether you can quickly understand unfamiliar software, troubleshoot independently, and confidently learn new systems than whether every tool happens to appear on your résumé.



## Communication Expectations



This role will eventually involve communicating externally on the client's behalf.



Excellent written and spoken English is therefore essential.



The successful EVA should be capable of:



- Learning the client's tone, preferences, and communication style.

- Drafting messages that sound natural rather than templated.

- Using AI responsibly to help replicate the client's voice without blindly sending AI-generated content.

- Communicating professionally with prospects, partners, event organizers, and other business contacts.

- Asking clear questions when information is genuinely missing.

- Providing concise updates without requiring the client to chase for status.

- Knowing when something can be handled independently and when the client needs to make the decision.



Voice notes, Slack,
, and Zoom may all be used depending on the situation.



## What We Are Looking For



### Required



- Strong written and spoken English.

- Experience providing executive, administrative, operations, or comparable remote support.

- Excellent online research skills.

- Strong organization and follow-through.

- Comfortable working with CRM and project-management systems.

- Comfortable using AI as a productivity tool.

- Ability to learn new technology independently.

- Ability to manage multiple ongoing conversations, tasks, and follow-ups.

- Strong judgment regarding priorities and escalation.

- Comfortable working within Mountain Time business operations.

- Reliable computer and internet connection suitable for professional remote work.

- Willingness to document processes and continuously improve how recurring work is handled.



### Preferred



Experience in one or more of the following would be particularly valuable:



- 

- Streak CRM

- Executive inbox and calendar management

- Lead generation

- Speaking opportunity research

- Podcast guest outreach

- Conference or event research

- Partnership or referral outreach

- CRM administration

- Business development support

- AI-assisted workflows

- Workflow automation

- SOP and process documentation



You do **not** need experience in every area listed above.



We would rather hire someone who demonstrates strong judgment, curiosity, ownership, and learning ability than someone with a long software list who needs instructions for every move.



## What It Means to Be an EVA at Project Outsource



At Project Outsource, an EVA is not simply an assistant who completes assigned tasks.



Our standard is **proactive ownership**.



We expect our EVAs to understand the intended outcome behind their work, learn the systems surrounding it, and progressively require less supervision as they develop familiarity with the client.



That means:



**Own the outcome.**  

If you accept responsibility for something, you are responsible for seeing it through.



**Communicate proactively.**  

Do not wait until a deadline has passed to announce that something is blocked. Raise issues early, explain what you have already tried, and identify what you need to move forward.



**Be resourceful before escalating.**  

Research. Search the documentation. Check the system. Use available tools. Think through the problem. Then ask for help when judgment, authorization, or missing information genuinely requires it.



**Document what you learn.**  

If something will happen again, help create a process for it. Good operations should become easier and more repeatable over time.



**Use AI intelligently.**  

AI is a tool, not a substitute for judgment. Use it to research, organize, draft, analyze, and accelerate work, but you remain accountable for the quality and accuracy of the final output.



**Improve the system.**  

If you repeatedly encounter the same inefficiency, do not simply become faster at tolerating it. Identify it, document it, and recommend a better way.



**Know when to escalate.**  

Ownership does not mean making decisions outside your authority. Strong EVAs know the difference between a problem they can solve and a decision the client needs to make.



## Our Culture: Be an Adult.



Project Outsource operates under one standing rule:



**Be an adult.**



Take ownership. See things through until they are done. Communicate when something is wrong. Keep your commitments. Ask for help when you genuinely need it. Treat clients, teammates, and confidential information with integrity.



We do not expect perfection.



We do expect accountability.



If you make a mistake, own it, correct it, learn from it, and help prevent it from happening again.



## What Success Looks Like



During the early stage of the engagement, success means learning the client's systems, organizing core administrative responsibilities, establishing reliable communication, and building trust.



From there, the EVA should progressively take ownership of recurring workflows, external communication, CRM management, research, outreach, and business-development support.



Over time, the client should no longer need to remember every follow-up, check every routine
, or personally keep every operational detail moving.



The long-term objective is simple:



**Become the person who helps make sure the business keeps moving even when the client is focused elsewhere.**



For the right person, this is intended to become a long-term relationship with increasing trust, autonomy, responsibility, and potential working hours.

title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter – U.S. Law Firms
description:
Cold Caller / Appointment Setter – U.S. Law Firms



We ares looking for an experienced, confident Cold Caller / Appointment Setter to contact attorneys and law firms throughout the United States.



This is a performance-based position with commission and appointment bonuses. We will provide the leads, calling lists, scripts, training, and sales materials.



About Us



We help law firms grow their practices through services including:



Google Business Profile optimization

Google Ads

Local SEO

Law firm website development and redesign

Online marketing and lead generation



The owner has practiced law in Beverly Hills, California for approximately 17 years before moving into law firm marketing.



We understand attorneys because we have been on their side of the desk.



Our initial focus will be primarily on bankruptcy attorneys, with additional practice areas being added later.



Your Primary Job



Your job is NOT to sell complicated marketing services over the telephone.



Your primary responsibility is to:



Call attorneys and law firms from lists that we provide.

Get through receptionists and gatekeepers.

Speak directly with attorneys or decision-makers whenever possible.

Give a short introduction to us.

Determine whether the attorney is interested in discussing ways to bring additional clients into their practice.

Schedule qualified appointments directly on our calendar.

Keep accurate notes regarding each conversation and follow-up.

Follow up with prospects when appropriate.



Once an attorney agrees to an appointment, we will handle the consultation and closing process.



Example of the Type of Call You Will Make



You may say something similar to:



“Hi, I'm calling for Joh Doe. John practiced bankruptcy law in Beverly Hills for about 17 years and now works specifically with law firms to help them bring in additional clients. He asked me to reach out to a few bankruptcy attorneys in your area. Would you have a few minutes this week to speak with him?”



You will receive additional scripts, responses to common objections, and training.



Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



Extremely comfortable making outbound cold calls.

Fluent in spoken English.

Easy for U.S. clients to understand over the telephone.

Professional and confident speaking with attorneys.

Comfortable dealing with receptionists and gatekeepers.

Persistent without being aggressive.

Friendly, conversational, and natural on the phone.

Able to think quickly instead of simply reading a script word-for-word.

Comfortable handling objections such as:

“We're not interested.”

“We already have a marketing company.”

“Send me an
.”

“The attorney isn't available.”

“We don't need any more clients.”

Organized and able to maintain accurate call notes.

Reliable and able to work independently.

Motivated by performance-based compensation.

Required Skills



Required:



Excellent spoken English

Previous cold-calling experience

Previous appointment-setting experience

Strong telephone communication skills

Ability to communicate professionally with U.S. businesses

Experience getting past gatekeepers

Ability to handle objections

Basic computer skills

Reliable high-speed internet

Quality headset and quiet work environment

Ability to work during U.S. business hours



Preferred but not required:



B2B cold-calling experience

Experience calling attorneys, accountants, doctors, or other professionals

Experience selling marketing, advertising, SEO, websites, Google Ads, or similar services

Experience using a CRM

Experience scheduling appointments through Calendly or similar systems

Previous experience calling U.S. businesses

Compensation



This is a performance-based position.



Compensation may include:



Payment for qualified appointments that actually attend their scheduled consultation.

Additional commission for each law firm that becomes a paying client.

Additional performance incentives may be available for top performers.



Our services can include an initial setup fee plus ongoing monthly management, so successful callers have the opportunity to earn meaningful commissions.



There is no predetermined limit on how many qualified appointments you can generate.



Leads Are Provided



You will NOT be required to find your own leads.



We provide lists of attorneys and law firms for you to contact.



Initially, you will primarily contact bankruptcy attorneys throughout the United States.



Work Schedule



You must be available to make calls during normal U.S. business hours.



Because you will be calling law offices, the majority of calling will take place Monday through Friday during the attorneys' local business hours.



We are looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term member of our team if the relationship works well.



Performance Expectations



We care about results, not simply the number of calls made.



We will monitor:



Calls completed

Decision-makers reached

Conversations with attorneys

Qualified appointments scheduled

Appointment show rate

New clients generated



Quality appointments are more important than simply filling the calendar with people who have no genuine interest.



How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:



1. Briefly describe your cold-calling experience.



Tell us what types of businesses or individuals you have called and approximately how long you have been cold calling.



2. Tell us about your appointment-setting experience.



What were you selling or promoting, and approximately how many appointments were you expected to schedule?



3. Describe your experience getting past gatekeepers.



Law firms frequently have receptionists or assistants screening calls. Tell us how you normally approach this situation.



4. Send a voice recording.



This is REQUIRED.



Please submit a 60–90 second recording introducing yourself and then pretend that you are calling a bankruptcy attorney using the following scenario:



“You are calling on behalf of our marketing office. The owner practiced bankruptcy law in Beverly Hills for approximately 17 years and now helps law firms bring in additional clients. Your goal is to get the attorney interested enough to schedule a short conversation.”



Do NOT simply read this description word-for-word. We want to hear how you naturally communicate on the telephone.



Applications without a voice recording may not be considered.



Important



We are NOT looking for someone who sounds like they are reading from a call-center script.



We want someone who can have a natural conversation with an attorney, build curiosity, handle objections professionally, and get the attorney to agree to a short conversation with our owner.



If you are confident on the telephone, competitive, persistent, and comfortable speaking with U.S. attorneys and business owners, we would like to hear from you.

title: Senior Creative Video Editor - DTC | Performance Marketing.
description:
READ FULL DESCRIPTION - ENGLISH MASTERY REQUIRED



We are looking for a highly skilled and creative DTC Video Editor to join our growing performance marketing team.



This role is focused on transforming raw video footage, UGC content, and existing creative assets into high-performing, short-form video advertisements for platforms like Meta, TikTok, and YouTube.



We're not looking for someone who simply follows editing instructions. We need someone who understands what makes a great advertisement, has a strong creative eye, and can independently turn raw footage into a polished, engaging final product.



Requirements & Responsibilities:



- You must have an exceptional understanding of spoken and written English, including tone, context, humour, and natural conversational language. This is essential for understanding scripts, selecting footage, and making creative editing decisions.

- Previous experience editing advertisements for DTC brands, affiliate marketers, or performance marketing agencies is required. You should understand the difference between editing content for entertainment and editing content designed to drive conversions.

- Creatively and efficiently transform raw footage, UGC content, and existing assets into polished, high-performing video advertisements.

- Demonstrate an exceptional understanding of pacing, storytelling, hooks, visual transitions, and audience retention.

- Have a strong creative eye and the ability to independently determine how a finished advertisement should look, feel, and flow.

- Understand how to structure short-form advertisements, including attention-grabbing hooks, engaging body content, and compelling calls to action.

- Be highly proficient in video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro or CapCut

- Source relevant, high-quality B-roll footage from platforms such as YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and other content libraries when necessary.

- Demonstrate strong skills in audio editing, sound design, music selection, captions, and visual effects that enhance the overall quality of an advertisement.

- Understand how to use existing footage creatively, including rearranging scenes, selecting the strongest takes, and incorporating visual elements that improve the final product.

- Be comfortable producing multiple creative variations from the same raw footage, including different hooks, pacing, and editing styles.

- Work independently with minimal creative direction while consistently delivering high-quality results.

- Manage deadlines, maintain organized project files, and consistently deliver work on schedule.



We maintain high creative standards and expect our editors to take pride in every advertisement they produce. Before submitting a completed project, you should independently review your work to ensure:



- Every cut, transition, and visual element feels intentional and polished.

- Captions are accurate, properly synchronized, and free from spelling or grammatical errors.

- Music, voiceovers, and sound effects are balanced and appropriately timed.

- B-roll footage is relevant to the dialogue and enhances the message rather than simply filling empty space.

- The advertisement maintains strong pacing and audience engagement throughout.

- There are no awkward pauses, unnecessary frames, abrupt audio transitions, or distracting visual inconsistencies.

- The finished video meets the creative brief and is ready for publication.



We expect editors to identify and correct issues independently. Your first submission should represent your best work, not a rough draft that requires extensive quality-control feedback.



Bonus Skills (Not Required):



- Previous experience editing advertisements in verticals such as GLP-1, Health & Wellness, Auto Insurance, Debt Relief, Home Insurance, ACA, Final Expense, Medicare, or other affiliate marketing industries.

- Experience working with established DTC brands or high-volume performance marketing agencies.

- Familiarity with Meta Ads Library and the ability to identify creative trends and editing styles used in successful advertisements.

- Experience editing direct-response UGC advertisements, testimonials, VSLs, or spokesperson-style videos.

- Experience with motion graphics, advanced text animations, or Adobe After Effects.

- Understanding of creative testing, including how different hooks, editing styles, and visual elements can influence advertising performance.

- Familiarity with AI-assisted editing tools and workflows.



What We're Looking For:

Above all, we're looking for someone with strong creative instincts and the ability to think like a performance marketer, not just a video editor.



You should be able to watch raw footage, understand the intended message, and independently make the creative decisions necessary to turn it into an effective advertisement.



We value editors who take ownership of their work, pay attention to the smallest details, and continuously look for ways to improve the quality and performance of their videos.



You will be working with an experienced performance marketing team that produces and tests creative content at scale.



Application Requirements:



You MUST provide a portfolio of your previous video editing work. Applications without a portfolio will be deleted.

Your portfolio should ideally include advertisements you have personally edited for DTC brands, affiliate marketers, or performance marketing campaigns.



Important: All portfolios are reviewed individually. Please only submit work that you personally created or substantially edited. Any misrepresentation of your experience or previous work will result in disqualification.

Strong written and spoken English.



Professional, persistent and courteous customer communication.

Background in industrial distribution, equipment rentals or service billing.

title: Head of TikTok Shop & Trybe
description:
# Head of TikTok Shop & Trybe



**Position:** Head of TikTok Shop & Creator Commerce

**Type:** Full-Time

**Experience Level:** Senior / Experienced

**Industry:** DTC Ecommerce



We are a rapidly growing ecommerce company looking for an **experienced TikTok Shop & Trybe operator to completely own this department**.



This is not a simple posting or virtual assistant position.



We are looking for someone who understands how to build, manage, optimize, and scale a **TikTok Shop creator ecosystem from the ground up**, while also managing our Trybe operation and turning creator content into a consistent acquisition and content engine.



You will be responsible for the performance of the channel.



What You'll Own



TikTok Shop Management



* Manage the entire TikTok Shop operation

* Recruit and onboard TikTok Shop affiliates and creators

* Conduct high-volume creator outreach

* Manage product sample requests and product seeding

* Build relationships with high-performing creators

* Identify creators with the highest revenue and content potential

* Create commission structures and creator incentives

* Launch creator campaigns and promotions

* Manage affiliate offers

* Optimize product listings and TikTok Shop storefront

* Monitor shop health and account performance

* Identify opportunities to increase GMV

* Track creator-level performance

* Analyze which hooks, creators, offers, and videos are generating sales

* Build systems for continuously increasing creator output

* Coordinate with creative, media buying, customer service, and operations teams



### Trybe Management



* Own our Trybe account and creator ecosystem

* Recruit and onboard high-performing creators into Trybe

* Manage creator posting and content distribution

* Ensure creators are consistently producing and submitting content

* Repurpose winning TikTok Shop content through Trybe

* Organize and manage creator content at scale

* Identify top-performing creators and double down on them

* Communicate winning hooks, concepts, offers, and angles to creators

* Create systems that encourage creators to iterate on winning ads

* Track creator output, performance, payouts, and activity

* Build a strong core group of creators producing content consistently



## Creator Management



A major part of this role is building relationships with creators.



You should know how to:



* Find creators who can actually sell products

* Recruit hundreds of potential affiliates

* Identify the top performers quickly

* Keep successful creators engaged

* Motivate creators to post more frequently

* Give creators feedback that improves their content

* Develop stronger relationships with our highest-value creators

* Create incentives, competitions, bonuses, and campaigns

* Build a community around the brand

* Turn occasional creators into long-term partners



We don't want someone who simply sends outreach messages.



**We want someone who can build a creator machine.**



## Performance & Reporting



You will be expected to track and report on metrics including:



* TikTok Shop GMV

* Revenue by creator

* Revenue by video

* Number of active creators

* New creators recruited

* Samples sent

* Sample-to-post rate

* Videos posted per week

* Revenue per creator

* Revenue per sample

* Affiliate commission

* Content volume

* Creator retention

* Top-performing hooks and concepts

* Trybe creator activity

* Trybe content output

* Top-performing creator content



You should constantly be asking:



**How do we get more high-quality creators producing more winning content?**



## Who We're Looking For



You MUST have previous experience managing **TikTok Shop for an established ecommerce brand.**



Ideal candidates have:



* Proven TikTok Shop management experience

* Experience growing TikTok Shop GMV

* Experience managing TikTok Shop affiliates

* Experience with creator outreach and product seeding

* Experience managing hundreds of creators or affiliates

* Strong understanding of TikTok Shop Seller Center

* Experience identifying and scaling top-performing creators

* Experience with Trybe is strongly preferred

* Strong understanding of direct-response ecommerce

* Strong analytical skills

* Excellent written communication

* Extremely organized

* Comfortable managing people, systems, and KPIs

* Ability to operate independently without constant direction



Experience with **high-volume DTC brands** is a major advantage.



## This Role Is NOT For You If



* You've only managed organic TikTok accounts

* You've never worked inside TikTok Shop

* Your experience is primarily social media scheduling

* You've never managed affiliates or creators

* You need detailed instructions for every task

* You're uncomfortable being accountable for revenue

* You've only worked with very small creator programs



## What Success Looks Like



Your goal is to turn TikTok Shop + Trybe into a **scalable creator acquisition and content engine**.



That means:



**More Creators ? More Content ? More Winning Creatives ? More Revenue**



You will have the autonomy to build the systems, team, processes, incentives, and creator relationships necessary to make that happen.



We are looking for someone who wants to **own a department**, not simply complete tasks.



## To Apply



Please include:



1. How many years of TikTok Shop experience you have

2. The largest TikTok Shop you've managed

3. Monthly GMV you helped generate

4. Number of creators/affiliates you've managed

5. Your experience with creator seeding and outreach

6. Your experience using Trybe

7. Examples of TikTok Shops you've worked on

8. A brief explanation of how you would build a creator program from 0 to 500+ active affiliates



**Applicants without direct TikTok Shop experience will not be considered.**

title: Video Editor
description:
Social Media Video Editor



About Prevvi



Prevvi is an IT and AI solutions company helping small and mid-sized businesses improve their technology environments and adopt AI in practical, secure, and scalable ways.



We are building an AI-driven content engine to help educate businesses about IT, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, emerging technology, and the rapidly changing technology landscape.



We are looking for a creative and highly capable Social Media Video Editor who can take AI-generated raw video footage and turn it into polished, engaging short-form content.



This is not a traditional virtual assistant position. Video editing quality is the most important part of this role.



The Role



You will work directly with Prevvi's founder.



Our internal AI systems handle much of the research, scripting, voice generation, and raw video creation. Your responsibility begins when the raw footage is ready.



You will take that footage and transform it into professional, engaging social media videos that look and feel intentionally produced rather than simply AI-generated.



The ideal person understands modern short-form content, strong visual storytelling, pacing, motion, captions, B-roll, sound, and what makes someone stop scrolling.



Over time, we would also like this person to contribute ideas and help improve the overall content production process.



Responsibilities



Your primary responsibilities will include:



- Edit raw talking-head and AI-generated video footage into polished short-form videos.

- Produce approximately 1–2 videos per day as the workflow becomes established.

- Create primarily 30–60 second social media videos, with occasional longer content when appropriate.

- Add professional transitions, motion graphics, animations, B-roll, screenshots, graphics, captions, and other visual elements.

- Improve pacing and storytelling so videos remain engaging from beginning to end.

- Add and balance music, sound effects, and audio where appropriate.

- Maintain consistent Prevvi branding across videos.

- Turn technology news, AI announcements, IT topics, and company content into visually compelling social media content.

- Work quickly when breaking technology or AI news occurs so Prevvi can publish while the topic is still timely.

- Prepare videos for platforms including LinkedIn, Instagram, and
.

- Upload and schedule approved content through GoHighLevel.

- Help maintain a consistent content calendar.

- Understand basic social media publishing practices, including appropriate posting times and formatting for different platforms.

- Suggest creative approaches, editing styles, content ideas, and improvements based on current social media trends.

- Help document and improve the editing workflow as the process evolves.

- Explore AI-assisted editing tools and automation where they improve speed without sacrificing quality.

- Incorporate feedback quickly and communicate clearly when questions arise.



### What We Are Looking For



The right person should have strong experience editing short-form social media content.



You should be able to demonstrate work that includes:



- Short-form video editing

- Professional transitions

- Motion graphics and animation

- B-roll integration

- Modern caption styles

- Strong pacing

- Sound design

- Visual storytelling

- Social-media-first editing



The specific editing software is less important than the quality of your work.



Experience with tools such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Canva, or similar platforms is welcome.



AI Experience



Prevvi is an AI-native company.



You do not need to be an AI engineer, but you should be comfortable working with AI-generated content and interested in learning new AI tools.



We encourage the use of AI when it makes the editing process faster or better.



However, the finished video should still look professionally edited. AI should assist the creative process, not replace attention to quality.



Social Media Experience



You should understand the basics of publishing content across:



- LinkedIn

- Instagram

-



Experience managing content calendars or social media scheduling platforms is strongly preferred.



Experience with GoHighLevel is helpful but not required. Training can be provided.



Personality and Working Style



We are looking for someone who is:



- Creative

- Proactive

- Organized

- Resourceful

- Detail-oriented

- Adaptable

- A strong communicator

- A self-starter

- Comfortable making suggestions rather than simply waiting for instructions

- Able to work independently

- Interested in technology, AI, and current trends

- Able to receive feedback and quickly iterate



We especially value someone who can look at a piece of content and say, “I think this would work better if we did it this way,” rather than simply completing the minimum requested task.



Schedule



This will initially be a part-time remote position of approximately 20 hours per week.



The expected schedule is approximately four hours per day, Monday through Friday.



An initial schedule of approximately 7:00 AM–11:00 AM Eastern Time may work well, although there is flexibility within roughly 7:00 AM–4:00 PM Eastern Time.



Some flexibility may occasionally be useful for time-sensitive content or coordination across time zones.



Communication



You will work primarily with Prevvi's founder.



Communication should be responsive, clear, and straightforward. WhatsApp or another agreed communication platform may be used for day-to-day collaboration.



Because technology news moves quickly, responsiveness is important when time-sensitive content needs to be published.



Success in This Role



Success is not measured simply by hours worked.



We are looking for someone who can help us build a repeatable content engine that consistently produces high-quality material.



A successful person in this role will:



- Consistently produce polished videos that meet Prevvi's quality standards.

- Help us reach a reliable cadence of 1–2 videos per day.

- Turn around time-sensitive content quickly.

- Require less direction as they learn our preferred style.

- Bring ideas rather than simply execute instructions.

- Help improve and document the production workflow.

- Increase production speed without sacrificing quality.

- Become a trusted creative partner as Prevvi grows.



Growth Opportunity



The immediate priority is video editing and social media content production.



For the right person, the position may expand over time into broader content marketing, social media management, brand development, and other marketing responsibilities as Prevvi grows.



We would rather hire someone exceptional at video editing who can grow into additional responsibilities than hire a general marketer who is only an average video editor.



Please provide:



1. Your resume or professional background.

2. A portfolio of short-form videos you personally edited.

3. Examples demonstrating transitions, animation, B-roll, captions, and modern social media editing.

4. The editing software you normally use.

5. Your hourly rate.

6. Your availability and normal working hours.

7. A short explanation of how you would improve a basic talking-head video to make it more engaging.



Selected candidates may be asked to complete a short paid editing exercise using sample footage so we can evaluate editing style, creativity, communication, and turnaround time.

title: Part-Time Construction Logistics & Ordering Coordinator
description:
We are a growing custom sauna construction company looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented person to help manage material ordering and project logistics.



This will start as a **part-time role of approximately 10 hours per week**, with the potential for additional hours and responsibility as the company grows.



The Role



Your primary responsibility will be making sure every construction project has the right materials, in the right quantities, at the right place, at the right time.



You will help us build a more predictable and efficient material-ordering system by reviewing completed projects, tracking actual material usage, and using that information to prepare future orders.



Responsibilities will include:



- Documenting how much lumber, wood paneling, insulation, hardware, and other materials were used on each project

- Comparing material usage across previous sauna projects

- Reviewing project dimensions, plans, and material requirements

- Calculating quantities needed for upcoming projects

- Maintaining organized material and ordering records

- Drafting and sending purchase-order
s to suppliers

- Confirming orders, quantities, pricing, delivery dates, and delivery locations

- Following up with vendors to make sure materials will arrive on schedule

- Coordinating deliveries so materials are available before our construction crew needs them

- Helping minimize both material shortages and unnecessary leftover material

- Improving our ordering process as we complete more projects



What Success Looks Like



When our crew arrives to begin a project:



Everything they need is already there.



Materials have been ordered correctly, deliveries have been coordinated, quantities are accurate, and the crew can begin working without delays.



At the end of the project, we should have enough material to comfortably complete the job without having a large amount of expensive material left over.



Who We're Looking For



This role requires someone who is extremely reliable and detail-oriented.



You should be someone who:



- Rarely lets details fall through the cracks

- Double-checks your work before placing or sending an order

- Is comfortable working with measurements, quantities, and basic math

- Can organize information across multiple projects

- Communicates clearly and professionally with suppliers

- Is comfortable following up when something isn't confirmed

- Can identify potential problems before they become problems

- Learns quickly and takes ownership of responsibilities



Experience with construction, lumber, building materials, estimating, purchasing, procurement, or project coordination is a major plus.



You do **not** need to be a construction expert, but you should either understand basic construction concepts or be confident that you can learn them quickly.



Hours



Approximately **10 hours per week to start**.



There is potential for this position to grow significantly as our construction volume increases.



About Us



We design and build premium custom Finnish-inspired saunas. Our projects involve specialty lumber, electrical equipment, glass, insulation, ventilation components, hardware, and other construction materials.



We are growing quickly and want to develop systems that allow our construction crews to focus on building while someone behind the scenes makes sure every project is properly prepared.



To Apply



Please send:



1. A brief introduction about yourself

2. Any experience you have with construction, purchasing, estimating, logistics, inventory, or project coordination

3. An example of a job where attention to detail was especially important

4. The systems or tools you have used to stay organized

5. Your current availability



Please begin your application with the words **“Materials Ready”** so we know you read the entire posting.
